title: 遭到流放的转生重骑士凭借游戏知识大开无双
content: "The Reincarnated Heavy Knight Who Uses Game Knowledge to Win Big" follows an ordinary young man who is a hardcore gamer. After being reincarnated into another world as a heavy knight, he is exiled from the royal capital due to misunderstandings and political schemes. Relying on the rich knowledge and tactical skills he learned from countless games in his past life, he roams a world filled with monsters, villains, and conspiracies, overcoming crises with clumsy-looking yet highly reliable heavy-armor combat. He masters map mechanics, monster weaknesses, and item combos while using management and strategic thinking to pave his way forward, growing from a scorned exile into a legendary knight. Blending isekai reincarnation, gaming strategy, and lighthearted humor, the story moves at a brisk pace and offers plenty of entertainment as the protagonist makes cool-headed decisions with charming contrast.

title: 飙马野郎 JOJO的奇妙冒险
content: "Steel Ball Run" is the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, set in the American West of 1890. To compete for the legendary Saint's Corpse that can revive the dead, several factions join a transcontinental super horse race. Protagonist Johnny Joestar, a once-brilliant jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, embarks on the journey with the help of the mysterious racer Gyro Zeppeli, getting caught up in the battle over the corpse. Combining horse racing, Stand abilities, western style, mystery, and the series' signature intelligence and passion, the story of Johnny and Gyro supporting each other, growing, and finding redemption on a brutal journey is deeply moving, widely hailed as the peak of the JoJo series.

title: THE WORLD IS DANCING 世界在起舞
content: "THE WORLD IS DANCING" is an original anime themed around dance, depicting a story of connecting hearts through dance around the world. The work revolves around a group of young people who love dancing, conveying emotions and dreams through dance styles from different regions, breaking through language and cultural barriers so strangers can meet and understand each other through rhythm. With gorgeous visuals, infectious beats, and diverse dance forms, it showcases the charm of dance as a universal language, blending themes of youth, friendship, and self-expression to create a vibrant and imaginative audiovisual experience. Viewers can feel the joy and healing dance brings, as well as the pure radiance of young people chasing what they love.

title: 哆啦A梦
content: "Doraemon" is a household classic sci-fi comedy anime. Doraemon, a cat-shaped robot from the 22nd century, is sent to modern times to help Nobita Nobi, an elementary school student who always gets into trouble. He solves Nobita's problems with various gadgets from his four-dimensional pocket, but often makes things worse, leading to a series of hilarious and heartwarming stories. The work blends themes of friendship, family, and growth into joyful daily life, depicting the childhood of Nobita and his friends Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo, teaching children courage, kindness, and persistence through imaginative gadget adventures. This national anime that has accompanied generations carries countless childhood memories and spreads warmth and positive energy.

title: 她和她的猫 -Everything Flows-
content: "She and Her Cat -Everything Flows-" adapts Shinkai Makoto's early short, told from the perspective of a stray black cat. After being adopted by a girl, the cat observes her loneliness, strength, and hidden softness in her solitary life through a cat's unique viewpoint. The story delicately depicts the silent companionship and understanding between cat and owner, using elegant visuals and poetic narration to present the warmth of interdependence between people and pets in urban life. With a slow, restrained pace, the film conveys deep reflections on loneliness, bonds, healing, and the dignity of life through the cat's eyes watching the changing seasons, scenery outside the window, and daily moments. It is a quiet, timeless healing short suitable for calm viewing amid a busy life.

title: 潮与虎 第二季
content: "Ushio and Tora" Season 2 adapts Fujita Kazuhiro's same-name action manga, following the adventures of boy Ushio Aotsuki and the ancient youkai Tora, who are rivals yet allies. Ushio, who has held his father's beast spear since childhood and possesses the power to repel youkai, teams up with Tora, a powerful youkai sealed by the spear for a thousand years. Bound by fate, they travel together, growing and trusting each other through battles against various youkai and the mastermind behind them. Season 2 pushes toward the final showdown with their archenemy Hakumen no Mono, unraveling a grand conspiracy spanning ancient and modern times. Known for its explosive fights, deep friendship, and family bonds, the growth of Ushio and Tora from adversaries to partners who entrust each other with their lives is highly moving, making this a classic of the youkai battle genre.

title: 宇宙巡警露露子
content: "Space Patrol Luluco" is an original short anime by TRIGGER, telling the hilarious adventures of space patrol officer Luluco. As the daughter of the space patrol chief, Luluco is full of justice yet impulsive and clumsy, constantly causing blunders. While fighting cosmic criminals with her partners, she falls in love with the son of a criminal during a mission, caught between justice and love. The work is known for exaggerated performances, breakneck pacing, and countless homages and gags, skillfully blending passion, absurdity, and a girl's heart into a whimsical, joke-packed, ultra-fast sci-fi comedy that can make viewers laugh within seconds.

title: 迷家
content: "Mayoiga" is an original mystery anime directed by Mizushima Tsutomu. Thirty men and women with diverse personalities, each bearing motives to escape reality, gather at an abandoned village called Nanakimura for a mysterious group event. As the investigation deepens, the village's eerie truth surfaces: a mysterious giant monster, old tales of missing villagers, and everyone's hidden past are revealed amid conflict and suspicion. Centering on collective psychology, utopian illusions, and human darkness, the work excels at oppressive mystery and ensemble characterization, exploring the fear, disguise, and redemption within people who flee reality, making it a chilling psychological suspense story.

title: 影鳄 承
content: "Kagewani: Sho" is the second season of the short horror anime Kagewani, continuing the established worldview. While investigating a series of bizarre disappearances and deaths, the protagonist discovers a mysterious existence called Kagewani silently devouring humans, its origins tied to ancient legends. This season reveals the truth of Kagewani's origins and conspiracies related to the organization behind the incidents. With cold tones, tight pacing, and escalating mysteries, it creates a suffocating horror atmosphere, blending urban legends, scientific investigation, and supernatural elements while constantly dropping hooks within limited runtime, keeping viewers on edge.

title: JOJO的奇妙冒险 不灭钻石
content: "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable" is the fourth part of the series, shifting the stage from Egypt to the peaceful Japanese town of Morioh. In 1999, Josuke Higashikata, a member of the Joestar family, returns to his hometown only to get caught up in a series of bizarre incidents caused by Stand users. To track down the Stand-using serial killer Yoshikage Kira, Josuke and his friends Koichi, Okuyasu, and Rohan investigate and battle. While retaining the series' passionate intelligence, this part adds the relaxed atmosphere of town life and absurd humor, featuring a colorful cast of characters with especially ingenious Stand designs and battles, culminating in a classic final showdown.

title: 火星异种 REVENGE
content: "Terra Formars: Revenge" is the second season of the Terra Formars anime. In the year 2599, humanity sends cockroaches to Mars to terraform the planet, only to face a furious counterattack centuries later from violently mutated, superpowerful Martian cockroaches. To reclaim Mars, nations dispatch genetically modified super soldiers in an expedition force to wage brutal battles against the powerful insects. This season further reveals the mystery of Martian evolution and the political conspiracies behind it, throwing Koma Koji and his companions into even more dangerous battlefields where they struggle to survive against all odds. The work is known for its passionate yet cruel battle scenes, desperate atmosphere, and spirit of sacrifice, exploring survival and humanity.

title: 逆转裁判
content: "Ace Attorney" adapts CAPCOM's same-name courtroom mystery game, following the story of rookie lawyer Phoenix Wright as he takes on cases full of reversals. Through meticulous investigation, sharp cross-examinations, and exposing contradictions in testimony, Phoenix clears the names of wrongly accused clients. The anime faithfully recreates the game's classic courtroom debates, with exaggerated performances, rousing music, and a satisfying pace that lets viewers experience the thrill of turning the truth around. Covering multiple bizarre cases from simple murders to serial conspiracies, it gradually unfolds Phoenix's complex entanglements with prosecutor Miles Edgeworth and friend Maya, a must-watch for mystery fans.

title: 学战都市 六芒星 第二季
content: "The Asterisk War" Season 2 adapts the same-name light novel, continuing the academy battle story of the water school city Seidoukan Academy. After enrolling with magical aptitude, boy Ayato Amagiri keeps growing stronger to uncover the truth behind his sister's disappearance, taking part in the Phoenix Festa that determines academy dominance. This season deepens the story as Ayato's past, the Asterisk Council, and the struggles among Star Pulse generations gradually become clear. He engages in fierce academy competitions and heated battles against powerful rivals while deepening bonds with female characters like Julis and Saya, making this a standard light-novel academy battle anime.

title: 忍者杀手 特别编辑版
content: "Ninja Slayer From Animation" adapts the same-name web novel, telling the story of a ninja slayer active in the shadows of modern Japan. Ordinary company employee Kenji Fujikido is dragged into a struggle between ninja organizations; after his beloved is cruelly killed, he is transformed into the Ninja Slayer by mysterious power, embarking on a thorny path of revenge against the ninja organization. The work is characterized by high-impact performances, fast and fierce ninja combat, and the exaggerated writing style unique to web novels, with bold, avant-garde visuals that freely switch between violence aesthetics and absurd comedy, creating a hardcore yet poetic underworld.

title: 机动战士高达独角兽 RE:0096
content: "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn RE:0096" is a TV version re-edited from the Gundam Unicorn OVA, set in the Universal Century year 0096. Boy Banagher Links accidentally encounters the mysterious mobile suit Unicorn Gundam and is drawn into the cosmic war over Laplace's Box. As the key to guiding humanity's future, Unicorn's NT-D system and Banagher's gradually awakening Newtype abilities take center stage. Known for its grand cosmic battle scenes, superb animation, deep political maneuvering, and reflections on war, Banagher's growth amid the clash of war and ideals makes this a highly acclaimed, epic work in the Gundam series.

title: 我的英雄学院
content: "My Hero Academia" adapts Kohei Horikoshi's same-name manga. In a world where superpowers are commonplace, Izuku Midoriya, a boy born without a Quirk, dreams of becoming a hero. After inheriting the power of the strongest hero All Might, he enters U.A. High School to train with classmates like Bakugo, Uraraka, and Todoroki, fighting the ever-growing League of Villains. Known for passionate hero training, deep bonds between companions, and distinctive Quirk designs, Izuku's journey from zero as he steps forward for others is deeply moving, with every battle and choice making viewers' blood boil.

title: 面包带来和平！
content: "Bread and Happiness!" is a lighthearted daily anime adapted from a yonkoma manga, depicting the ordinary working days of sixteen-year-old Minami at a bakery. With gentle words, sincere smiles, and hand-made bread, she gradually heals the guests and friends around her. Without strong dramatic conflict, the work shows the subtle kindness and bonds between people through warm little stories, with the aroma of bread seemingly wafting through the screen. With a fresh art style and slow, soothing pacing, it is filled with the warm atmosphere typical of healing works, perfect for relaxing during times of fatigue.

title: 超时空要塞Δ
content: "Macross Delta" is the latest installment of the Macross series. In a future where humanity coexists with various galactic civilizations, the Valkyrie flight units and the idol group Walküre fight side by side. The girls' songs possess the power to calm those infected by the Var syndrome, while the enemy's songs bring destruction and madness. The story follows ace pilot Hayate and singer Freyja as they grow, blending gorgeous aerial combat, moving music, and a love triangle, exploring war, peace, and bonds amid the flames of battle, renowned for fluid dogfight animation and infectious songs.

title: Concrete Revolutio 超人幻想 THE LAST SONG
content: "Concrete Revolutio: The Last Song" is the second season of this anime. In an alternate era, superhumans, youkai, robots, and other beings exist in society, and the state establishes a Superhuman Bureau to register and regulate them. Season 2 revolves around the position conflicts of Jirou Hitoyoshi and the Bureau members amid changing times, showing superhumans' difficult choices between justice and order, ideals and reality. The work is known for its complex narrative structure, sharp social criticism, and numerous historical references, exploring weighty themes of heroes, humanity, and the times, standing as a uniquely styled fantasy ensemble drama.

title: 偶像活动 第二年
content: "Aikatsu!" Season 2 is the sequel to the idol activity series, continuing the idol life of Ichigo Hoshimiya and other girls at Starlight Academy. Ichigo keeps growing in her idol activities, meeting new rivals and friends and participating in various events and auditions as she advances toward becoming a top idol. Building on the previous season's bright style, this season enriches character relationships and stage performances, using gorgeous fashion, moving songs and dances, and dream-filled plots to depict the girls' youthful journey of chasing dreams and shining, letting viewers feel the sparkle and emotion of the idol world.

title: 苍翼默示录 Alter Memory
content: "BlazBlue Alter Memory" adapts the same-name 2D fighting game, telling of the battle over the grimoires and the Azure successor. In a world where city classes are severely divided and social contradictions intensify, awakened ones and magi are drawn into a brutal war over the Azure power. Protagonist Ragna fights to oppose the one who caused the world's collapse, entangled in complex, fateful relations with his sister Nu and a colorful cast of characters. Known for gorgeous fighting scenes, a vast and diverse worldview, and highly individual designs, the anime condenses the feuds and stories of popular game characters into an exciting, profound work and a representative fighting-game adaptation.

title: 苍蓝钢铁的琶音
content: "Arpeggio of Blue Steel" adapts the same-name manga, telling a sci-fi naval battle story between humanity and warship girls with self-awareness. Due to the total blockade by the mysterious fleet Fog, humanity loses control of the seas and can only huddle on land. Boy Chihaya Gunzou boards the Fog warship I-401 by chance and forms a contract with its Mental Model girl Iona to fight for reclaiming the seas. The work skillfully combines realistic naval research with sci-fi settings, exploring self-awareness, trust, and the boundaries of humanity, renowned for detailed warship art, grand naval battles, and thought-provoking themes, offering both excitement and depth.

title: 革命机Valvrave 第二季
content: "Valvrave the Liberator" Season 2 continues the first season, telling of boy Tokishima Haruto's battles with the Valvrave. After being drawn into international conflict, Haruto becomes a Valvrave pilot, fighting the oppression of a powerful empire alongside the princess of a fallen nation and his fellow Sakimori Academy students. In Season 2, the truth about the Valvrave, immortals, and humanity's future gradually emerges; Haruto pays heavy prices for his power and faces even crueler choices and sacrifices. Characterized by grand mecha warfare, complex political maneuvering, and intense emotional entanglements, the story's twists and turns make it a highly controversial original robot anime.

title: 萌萌侵略者
content: "Outbreak Company" adapts the same-name light novel, telling of otaku high schooler Kano Shinichi being recruited as the otaku ambassador to Japan in another world, promoting 2D culture in a magical world. He lives with half-elf maid Myu, dragon-person Raccoon, and other distinct companions, gradually changing this closed world through anime, games, and manga subculture. The work blends isekai, otaku culture, and light comedy, showing both love and satire for otaku culture while exploring themes of cultural exchange, dissolving prejudice, and understanding. Shinichi's idea of conquering another world with 2D content is full of fun, making this a lighthearted isekai slice-of-life series.

title: 斩服少女
content: "Kill la Kill" is an original passionate anime by TRIGGER. Transfer student Ryuko Matoi wields the kamui Senketsu, charging into Honnouji Academy to find her father's killer, battling Satsuki Kiryuin, who rules the school, and her elite Four Devas. As battles advance, a grand conspiracy surrounding the kamui, Life Fibers, and human instinct gradually surfaces. Known for exaggerated, explosive animation, show-stopping performances, and fast, satisfying fights, the growth of Ryuko and Senketsu from mutual distrust to fighting side by side is thrilling, full of power and visual impact, making it a generation-defining classic of action anime.

title: IS〈无限斯特拉托斯〉第二季
content: "Infinite Stratos" Season 2 adapts the same-name light novel, telling of the sole male pilot of the female-only weapon IS, Ichika Orimura, and his academy battle comedy life among numerous female characters. Continuing from the first season, Ichika deepens bonds with companions during school festivals, training, and tournaments while facing new strong enemies and trials, gradually revealing his powerful machine control abilities. With gorgeous mecha combat, harem romance, and lighthearted daily life as selling points, the interactions between Ichika and the female cast are full of laughs and ambiguity, making this a typical light-novel academy battle harem series.

title: 京骚戏画
content: "Kyousougiga" adapts the same-name short anime. In the Mirror Capital, where chaos and order intertwine, girl Koto embarks on a strange adventure to find her missing father. The Mirror Capital is a magical world where humans and youkai coexist; Koto meets youkai with various purposes and gets caught up in events surrounding the capital's mysteries and the truth of creation. Known for bold, unrestrained colors, unique beautiful Japanese-style visuals, and boundless imagination, the work freely shifts between intense action and profound storytelling, telling a gentle yet grand story about family, bonds, time, and the world, with a highly distinctive artistic style.

title: 核爆默示录
content: "Coppelion" adapts the same-name manga, set in a near-future Tokyo reduced to a dead city by a nuclear power plant accident, following special-forces sisters performing dangerous missions in the ruins. Protagonist Ibara Naruse and her two sisters enter the contaminated zone to rescue survivors and investigate the truth, wearing heavy protective suits as they move through the perilous city, racing against time and fighting radiation. Set against the desolate post-disaster city, the work explores themes of hope, responsibility, and survival through the girls' courage and sacrifice, carrying strong real-world parallels with a tense, heavy atmosphere.

title: 高达创战者
content: "Gundam Build Fighters" is a spin-off of the Gundam series, telling a passionate story of battles using Gunpla (Gundam models). The Gunpla made by boy Iori Sei is unexpectedly piloted by the mysterious master Reiji, and the two team up to compete in the All-Japan Gunpla Battle tournament. The work perfectly combines model building and virtual battles, presented in a bright, lively style with tense model battles, character growth and friendship, and plenty of homages and gags to Gundam works across generations. Both longtime Gundam fans and new viewers can feel the passion and fun of models and battles.

title: 青春纪行
content: "Golden Time" adapts Banri Takemiya's same-name light novel. College student Tada Banri gradually loses his memories from before high school after enrolling, yet remains troubled by his past self. He meets gentle senior Linda and romantic rival Mitsuo Yanagisawa, unfolding a love story full of the bitterness and sweetness of youth. The work delicately depicts memory, growth, and choice, exploring how people move forward after losing their past. Banri's struggle between reality and hazy memories and Linda's hidden feelings are portrayed movingly, making this a realistic yet gentle youth romance.

title: 我的脑内选项正在全力妨碍学园恋爱喜剧
content: "Noucome: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering with My School Romantic Comedy" adapts the same-name light novel. High schooler Kanade Amakusa is frequently hit with sudden mandatory choices in his head that force him into embarrassing acts, earning him the title of the Absolute Choice holder. One day he meets a girl claiming to be a god, and guided by absolute choices, he gradually gets involved in romantic comedy with school girls. With gag-style settings, exaggerated comedic performances, and endless gags, the work advances multiple love lines amid funny daily life; Kanade's struggling figure before ridiculous choices is hilarious, making this a lighthearted school romance comedy.

title: 当不成勇者的我，只好认真找工作了。
content: "When I Couldn't Become a Hero, I Decided to Look for a Real Job" adapts the same-name light novel. After the Demon Lord is defeated by the hero, the world gains peace, but the Demon Lord's son Raul loses his inherited mission and becomes an ordinary young man who ends up working at a magic shop. He works alongside Fen, a girl from the former Demon King army who comes to apply, causing all sorts of jokes in their daily work while gradually adapting to ordinary life. With an isekai part-time job theme and light comedy, the work cleverly combines fantasy settings with workplace daily life; the interactions of this odd pair are full of charm and laughs, making it a relaxing isekai slice-of-life series.

title: 东京暗鸦
content: "Tokyo Ravens" adapts the same-name light novel. In modern Tokyo, the secret war between onmyoji and curse users never ceases. Self-proclaimed unqualified onmyoji Harutora Tsuchimikado is forced back into the onmyoji world after being involved in an incident, facing curses and conspiracies with childhood friend Natsume and friend Suzuka. Blending onmyo arts, passionate battles, and school life, the story unfolds around Harutora's hidden lineage, Natsume's fate, and the great truth behind spirit disasters, with meticulous settings and solid character growth, making it a popular supernatural battle work.

title: 噬血狂袭
content: "Strike the Blood" adapts the same-name light novel. The world's strongest vampire, Akatsuki Kojou, enters Saikai Academy on Itogami Island as a monitor, teaming up with the Sword Shaman girl Yukina Himeragi. The two deepen their bond fighting demon races, holy war organizations, and various conspiracies while Kojou's hidden vampire power gradually awakens. Set in a modern fantasy city, the work blends battle, school life, and romance, with tense combat scenes and lighthearted ambiguous daily interactions; the chemistry of this bickering pair is beloved, making it a typical modern fantasy battle series.

title: 白色相簿2
content: "White Album 2" adapts the same-name bishoujo game. Haruki Kitahara of the high school light music club meets Setsuna Ogiso, a girl with a gifted voice, before the school festival, as well as the talented but aloof genius Touma Kazusa; the three become entangled in a complex emotional web through music. Known for delicate psychological portrayal, a suffocating yet realistic atmosphere, and mature romantic storytelling, the bitterness, hesitation, and choices of the love triangle became a classic topic fans endlessly discuss. With its tearjerking plot and overwhelming emotional outbursts, it stands as a famous work that romance anime cannot avoid.

title: 零度战姬Vibration
content: "Freezing Vibration" is the second season of the Freezing anime. Under the threat of the extra-dimensional beings called NOVA, humanity cultivates Pandora warriors, Saint holders who can fight them. This season revolves around the battles and bonds of Kazuya Aoi and Satellizer, further revealing the truth of NOVA, the Pandoras' mission, and each one's past. Characterized by gorgeous passionate battles and vivid characterization, the work intersperses ambiguity and fan-service amid intense fights, creating powerful warrior girls with a balance of passion and melancholy.

title: Little Busters! 〜Refrain〜
content: "Little Busters! Refrain" is the second season of this game adaptation and its core arc. Riki Naoe and the Little Busters gradually come into contact with the world's secret during school life; this season unveils the truth behind the scenes, telling a deeply moving story of world repetition, the sacrifice of friends, and reunion. With friendship and bonds as its theme, the work uses layered storytelling and tearjerking narration to present the boys' determination to overcome hardships together; Riki's choice before the truth is deeply moving. As a Key work, it continues the studio's signature tearjerking warmth with immense emotional impact.

title: 机巧少女不会受伤
content: "Unbreakable Machine-Doll" adapts the same-name light novel. In a magic world academy, mechanicians who manipulate dolls and automatons coexist. Boy Raishin enrolls to become a mechanician but is attacked by his own automaton Yaya after a defeat; the two form a rivals-turned-allies relationship amid conflict and adjustment. With academy battles and machine-doll settings as its features, Raishin and Yaya keep growing through competitions while gradually uncovering the conspiracy behind the academy. Battle scenes are gorgeous, and the sharp-tongued banter between Raishin and Yaya is hilarious, making this a classic machine-doll battle adaptation.

title: 境界的彼方
content: "Beyond the Boundary" adapts the same-name light novel. In a world where humans and youmu coexist, half-youmu boy Akihito Kanbara, who can control blood, meets the strongest youmu hunter Mirai Kuriyama. Mirai gets drawn into youmu hunting due to her special reaction to Akihito, and the two grow closer as they fight side by side. Blending fantasy battles and school romance, the work's greatest highlights are Kyoto Animation's delicate animation, gentle emotional portrayal, and outstanding direction. The contrasting yet endearing pair of Akihito and Mirai heals and tugs at the heart, and the relief of the ending lingers long.

title: 夜樱四重奏 花之歌
content: "Yozakura Quartet: Hana no Uta" adapts the same-name manga, telling of the town of Sakurashin where humans and youkai coexist. To resolve the constant youkai incidents in town, boys and girls with power form a guardian group to fight forces threatening the town. Centering on four protagonists, this season shows their growth and bonds in protecting the town while revealing its deep secrets. With Japanese-style fantasy as its foundation, the work blends action, daily life, and mystery, with well-rounded characters and fluid battle scenes, creating a fantasy atmosphere that is both warm and slightly dangerous.

title: 黑子的篮球 第二季
content: "Kuroko's Basketball" Season 2 continues the first season, following the growth of the Phantom Sixth Man Tetsuya Kuroko and Taiga Kagami. Their Seirin High basketball team fights to dominate the nation, facing members of the Generation of Miracles such as Daiki Aomine, Seijuro Akashi, and Ryota Kise in spectacular games. Known for exaggerated superpower basketball skills, tense match scenes, and passionate teamwork, the combination of Kuroko's misdirection and Kagami's jumping power is a highlight, with every comeback breathtaking, making it a representative sports anime.

title: 眼镜部
content: "Meganebu!" is an original school anime telling the daily lives of high schoolers who love glasses. Main character Yomogi Mitsuba joins the Glasses Club after enrolling, discussing glasses and holding various activities with members, from frame matching to vision topics. With glasses as the bond, the work depicts the boys' pure friendship and ordinary warm school life, with a clean art style and a lighthearted, healing atmosphere, giving substance to the love of glasses and letting viewers feel the beauty and simple joy of youth through daily interactions.

title: 天方魔谭MAGI 第二季
content: "Magi: The Kingdom of Magic" Season 2 adapts the same-name manga, continuing the adventures of Aladdin and Alibaba. This season revolves around the Magnostadt Academy and the war of magi, with Aladdin getting caught up in national conflicts while learning magic and Alibaba searching for his own path amid confusion. Known for its grand worldview, rich fantasy settings, and thrilling battles, the work also deeply explores themes of power, nations, and slavery; the choices and bonds of best friends Aladdin and Alibaba as they grow are moving, making it an excellent fantasy adventure.

title: 精灵宝可梦XY
content: "Pokémon the Series: XY" is the sixth installment of the Pokémon anime, set in the beautiful Kalos region. Ash and Pikachu meet new friends in Kalos, challenge gym badges, and travel with companions Clemont and Bonnie. The work highlights gorgeous battle visuals, the introduction of Mega Evolution, and Ash's battles against rivals and champion Diantha, showcasing the deep bond between trainers and Pokémon. While retaining the classic adventure core, the art and performances are greatly enhanced, making it a highly acclaimed and popular installment.

title: 飙速宅男
content: "Yowamushi Pedal" adapts the same-name manga, telling of otaku high schooler Sakamichi Onoda finding his dream in cycling. Good at climbing, Onoda joins the Sohoku High cycling club and competes in high school races with teammates Imaizumi and Naruko, growing through intense road races. Known for its detailed depiction of race tactics, teamwork, and passionate scenes, the work brings out the charm of road cycling; Onoda's transformation from an introverted otaku to an ace rider is deeply moving, making it an adrenaline-pumping sports anime.

title: 钻石王牌
content: "Ace of Diamond" adapts the same-name baseball manga, telling the passionate story of Seidou High's baseball club. Protagonist Eijun Sawamura joins Seidou with his unique pitching, striving for Koshien alongside genius catcher Miyuki and many teammates. Known for realistic baseball tactics, detailed game portrayal, and character growth, the work depicts the youthful ensemble of boys chasing baseball dreams; Sawamura's journey from being doubted to gradually earning recognition is real and moving, with the team's unity and bonds running throughout, making it a classic baseball anime.

title: 武士弗拉明戈
content: "Samurai Flamenco" is an original anime. Ordinary young man Masayoshi Hazama, after becoming a volunteer police officer, is unexpectedly drawn into real crime and hero struggles. The partner he meets, Goto Hidenori, and the mysterious existence named Flamenco shift the story from light comedy to a serious, grand hero saga. Known for unexpected plot developments, a unique view of heroes, and powerful performances, the seemingly gag-like premise receives a shocking turn in the latter half; its exploration of social phenomena and the definition of heroes is impressive, making it a highly topical original work.

title: 伽利略少女
content: "Galilei Donna" is an original anime telling the story of three sisters who are descendants of Galileo. The three descendants have their own talents and personalities but are accidentally drawn into an international conflict over the treasure left by their grandfather. Using Galileo's legacy as a clue, the work unfolds a journey full of science and adventure, with the sisters deepening their bonds while pursuing the truth. Combining science elements, action adventure, and heartwarming daily life, the fresh bright art style, vivid characters, and well-balanced pacing make it a light yet fun adventure anime.

title: Phi-Brain～神之谜题3
content: "Phi Brain: Puzzle of God" Season 3 is the third season of this puzzle anime. Genius puzzle solver Kaito Daimon continues challenging the ancient puzzles called the Puzzle of God to save trapped companions and friends. This season introduces new puzzle mechanisms and powerful rivals, further honing Kaito's puzzle abilities as he faces even tougher trials. With intellectual puzzle solving and tense duels as its features, every puzzle is ingeniously designed to test wisdom and logic; Kaito's cool head and his companions' cooperation are astonishing, making it a rare gem among puzzle anime.

title: 记录的地平线
content: "Log Horizon" adapts the same-name light novel. After the update of the online game Elder Tale, more than thirty thousand players are trapped in the game world unable to log out. Veteran player Shiroe, with wisdom and leadership, establishes influence in the game world and searches for a way to return to reality. With strategy, management, and MMO settings as its features, Shiroe's cool-headed mind games, team organization, and class coordination are highlights; the ensemble portrayal of players living together is detailed, and the worldview is rigorous, making it a classic of MMO anime.

title: 声优战队
content: "Voice Actor Squadron" is an original anime themed around the voice acting industry, depicting young voice actors entering a voice acting school and striving to become professionals. The work is packed with real industry details, audition processes, and comedic bits, with characters growing through recording studios, agencies, and daily life. Using voice work as an entry point, it showcases the charm and behind-the-scenes hardship of the world of sound; the protagonists' sincere pursuit of their voice acting dreams is touching while also full of lighthearted comedy, a must-see for fans of the voice acting world.

title: 第一神拳 Rising
content: "Hajime no Ippo: Rising" is the third season of the classic boxing anime. Ippo Makunouchi continues training at the Kamogawa gym, challenging stronger opponents on his way to becoming a world-class champion. This season Ippo faces even harsher rivals, experiencing defeats and breakthroughs in the ring to refine greater power. Known for realistic boxing portrayal, passionate match scenes, and character growth, every bout is full of tension and emotion, with equally well-rounded opponents; viewers can feel the charm of boxing and the resilience of athletes, making it a representative boxing anime.

title: 摸索吧！部活剧
content: This is the experimental short anime where high school girls form a club and search for a club activity direction. The protagonists advance the plot through improvisational performances and dialogue, full of experimentation and comedy, breaking the traditional narrative framework of anime. Characterized by unique directing techniques, fourth-wall-breaking humor, and parody of anime production, the characters joke around and let loose in absurd club ideas, delivering astonishing joke density in short episodes - an experimental gag anime brimming with meme spirit.

title: 黑白小姐
content: "Miss Monochrome" is a virtual idol short anime. The protagonist Miss Monochrome is a robot girl who loves idols; awakened from a long slumber by chance, she works hard to become an idol. Characterized by exaggerated performances, rapid-fire gags, and absurd plots, Miss Monochrome causes all kinds of hilarious trouble while chasing her dreams, from daily trivialities to idol activities. With an extremely fast pace and dense jokes, the work creates the lovably silly yet persistent image of Miss Monochrome, making it a lighthearted, stress-relieving short anime.

title: 噗哔啵 来自未来
content: "Pupipo!" is a short anime telling the heartwarming daily life of a mysterious creature from the future named Pupipo and a human girl. With strange abilities, Pupipo triggers a series of light, funny events with the girl and gradually becomes an important partner to her. With a unique art style and healing atmosphere, the work uses simple storytelling to show the warmth and bond between humans and a mysterious creature, without intense conflict—only daily warmth and small surprises, perfect for relaxing viewing between busy moments to feel that pure beauty.

title: 悠哉日常大王
content: "Non Non Biyori" adapts the same-name manga, depicting the leisurely daily life of the Koshigaya sisters in a rural elementary school and transfer student Renge Miyauchi. The work portrays Japan's countryside scenery across four seasons and the simple lives of children, known for its slow pacing, fresh art style, and healing atmosphere. Renge's innocent catchphrases, the interactions between sisters, and the details of country life bring smiles, showing the quiet beauty of pastoral life to the fullest. It is a representative healing daily anime that lets viewers find inner peace amid the bustle of life.

title: 银狐
content: "Gingitsune" adapts the same-name manga, telling the heartwarming daily life of shrine maiden Makoto Saeki and fox spirit messenger Gintaro. Makoto is the shrine maiden of Uedaten Shrine; Gintaro, who can communicate with the gods, is sharp-tongued yet always quietly protects her. The work revolves around shrine rituals, visitors' wishes, and the girl's growth, depicting the bond and warmth between humans and spirit messengers through small stories tied to the shrine. With delicate art and a tranquil atmosphere, Makoto gradually understands the duties of shrine maiden and spirit messenger with Gintaro's company, making it a healing daily work.

title: 少女骑士物语
content: "Aokana: Four Rhythm Across the Blue" adapts the same-name game. In a knight academy, girls take pride in competing by riding horses and using lances and swords. Protagonist Mizuhara Takahiro, after being injured, shifts to supporting the girls, helping knight trainees and building deep trust with them. Centered on academy knight competition and romance, the work depicts the girls' graceful figures on horseback and their youth; gorgeous knight equipment, thrilling matches, and delicate emotions intertwine, and the interactions between Takahiro and each knight girl are charming, making it a work combining competitive passion and romantic atmosphere.

title: 来自风平浪静的明天
content: "Nagi no Asukara" is an original anime by P.A.WORKS, telling the youth story of boys and girls from two worlds, the sea and the land. The youths of the undersea village Shioshishio are forced to transfer to a land school due to tidal changes, meeting land companions and becoming entangled in love and friendship. Known for delicate emotional portrayal, magnificent ocean scenery, and refined animation, the love triangles and growth of five young people unfold layer by layer, with the metaphor of tides and time running through the film. It is a visually beautiful, emotionally deep, tearjerking youth ensemble drama.

title: 想成为世界最强
content: "Want to Be the Strongest in the World!" adapts the same-name light novel. Popular idol Sakura Hagiwara turns to professional wrestling after an injury, growing on the wrestling stage. Centered on women's pro wrestling, Sakura and her companions challenge their limits in training and matches, gradually gaining recognition from audiences. Blending idol and wrestling elements, the work has both the glamour of idols and the sweat and passion of the ring; Sakura's determination and effort to transform from idol to wrestler are moving, with powerful match scenes, making it a distinctive sports work.

title: 网球并不可笑嘛 3期
content: "Teekyu" is a short gag anime depicting the absurd daily lives of tennis club girls. Characterized by rapid-fire gags, exaggerated performances, and wildly imaginative bits, the work turns serious tennis matches into a series of hilarious scenes, with the characters constantly falling into chaos and blunders. Each episode is extremely short yet dense with jokes; the stupid club members' mishaps in matches and practice never end, making it a hilarious light short anime perfect for stress relief in spare moments.

title: 限制级杀手
content: This is a gag anime about an assassin. A mysterious assassin carries out various assassination missions in unexpected ways yet always runs into hilarious, laughable unexpected trouble. Characterized by deadpan humor and exaggerated violent comedy, the work switches freely between serious missions and absurd daily life, with absurd plots and brisk pacing. The protagonist's contrasting performance, bizarre behavior, and the motley cast of the underworld create a unique black-humor atmosphere that also playfully mocks the assassin profession beneath the lighthearted surface - a distinctive work.

title: 名侦探柯南
content: "Detective Conan" is a household classic mystery anime. High school detective Shinichi Kudo is shrunk after being poisoned by the Black Organization, taking the name Conan Edogawa and living with Mori Kogoro, continuing to solve difficult cases under the guise of a child. The work revolves around countless ingenious murder mysteries and the Black Organization's conspiracies; Conan's cooperation with Ai Haibara, Heiji Hattori, and others, along with his romance with Ran, forms a decades-spanning mystery classic. From locked-room murders to the flashy appearances of Phantom Thief Kid, Conan uncovers the truth with meticulous reasoning, accompanying countless viewers through their growing years.

title: 航海王
content: "One Piece" adapts Eiichiro Oda's same-name manga. Boy Luffy sets out to become the Pirate King, forming the Straw Hat crew with his companions and sailing the Grand Line in search of the legendary treasure One Piece. Known for passionate adventures, bonds between companions, and a grand worldview, Luffy deepens friendships with Zoro, Nami, Sanji, Usopp, and others through battles while being drawn into epic showdowns with the Marines, the Four Emperors, and the World Government. From setting sail in the East Blue to the New World, Luffy moves everyone with freedom and dreams; the vast saga and moving stories of the manga and anime make it a true national-level work.

title: 火影忍者疾风传
content: "Naruto Shippuden" is the sequel to Naruto, telling of Naruto's growth after returning from training. Naruto and friends Sakura and Sasuke carry out missions in the Leaf Village, gradually drawn into the whirlpool of Orochimaru, the Akatsuki, and the Fourth Great Ninja War. Centered on ninja battles, bonds, and peace, Naruto grows with unyielding perseverance and tailed beast power, with the fateful duel against Sasuke running throughout. From genin to hero of the ninja world, Naruto changes many people's fates with his talk-no-jutsu and strength, ultimately protecting his precious comrades and the peace of the ninja world—a passionate classic in countless people's youthful memories.

title: 王者天下 第二季
content: "Kingdom" Season 2 adapts the same-name manga, set in late Warring States China. Boy Shin, aiming to become a great general, meets his best friend Hyou and the great general Ou Ki amid Qin's campaigns, gradually getting drawn into the grand war of unifying the world. This season continues historical events like the Qin-Zhao war, showing Shin's growth on the battlefield and the splendor of various scholars and famous generals. Known for grand war scenes, passionate character growth, and authentic historical background, Shin's bravery and persistence are moving; the historical panorama of Qin unifying the six states unfolds in animation, making it an outstanding historical anime.

title: 探险托里兰托 1000年的真宝
content: This is an original adventure anime telling the treasure-hunting adventures of young explorers. The protagonist and his companions set out to find the legendary treasure buried for a thousand years, facing all kinds of dangers and puzzles on the mysterious Toritoranto continent. With light adventure and companion bonds as its features, the journey is filled with traps, monsters, and treasure legends one after another; the boys overcome crises with courage and wisdom, suitable for younger viewers. The brisk, positive atmosphere conveys the adventurous spirit of exploration.

title: 美妙旋律 Rainbow Live
content: "Pretty Rhythm: Rainbow Live" is the fourth season of the Pretty Rhythm series, telling of girls realizing their dreams through dance and fashion. Protagonist Naru Ayase becomes a star with her innate dancing skills after hearing the Prism Melody, continuously challenging herself on stage. With gorgeous stage performances, fashion elements, and the girls' growth as the main line, the work shows the sparkle and challenges of the idol world; Naru and her friends deepen their bonds through competitions and performances, and the song-and-dance scenes are infectious, making it a classic series among girls' idol anime.

title: 物语系列 第二季
content: "Monogatari Series: Second Season" is the second season of the anime adapted from Nisio Isin's novels. This season unfolds through several independent yet interwoven storylines, as Koyomi Araragi's past with vampires, oddities, and friends is peeled back, with arcs featuring Deishu Kaiki, Hitagi Senjougahara, and Oshino Ougi. Known for its unique dialogue style, extreme visual expression, and thought-provoking narration, the work perfectly blends romance, mystery, philosophy, and gags; Araragi keeps growing through oddity incidents. The camera language and color use are textbook-level, making it an artistically acclaimed masterpiece.

title: 宇宙兄弟
content: "Space Brothers" adapts the same-name manga, telling the story of two brothers chasing their astronaut dreams. After younger brother Hibito becomes an astronaut, older brother Mutta reignites his childhood dream, passing through rigorous selection to join JAXA and challenge space. Known for authentic space knowledge, warm brotherly bonds, and inspiring growth stories, Mutta's transformation from a discouraged middle-aged man to an astronaut candidate is full of hope and emotion; the hardship and romance of space development intertwine, and the characters' persistence in pursuing dreams is inspiring, making it a powerful and warm work.

title: 猎人
content: "Hunter x Hunter" adapts Yoshihiro Togashi's same-name manga. Boy Gon sets out on the Hunter Exam to find his father, a Hunter, fighting alongside companions Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio. Known for its ingenious Nen ability battle system and narrative that blends coldness with warmth, arcs like the Hunter Exam, the Zoldyck family, the Phantom Troupe, and Greed Island are gripping. Gon's purity and persistence, Killua's struggles and growth, and Kurapika's path of revenge all show the depth of human nature under Togashi's pen, making it a classic full of substance among battle manga.

title: 圣斗士星矢Ω
content: "Saint Seiya Omega" is a new installment of the Saint Seiya series. Kouga, a Saint who lost his memory, becomes a Saint of the new generation under Athena's guidance, fighting with companions to protect the peace of the earth. The work introduces new-generation characters while retaining classic Saint Seiya settings, unfolding adventures around new threats like the God of Mars. Kouga grows from an amnesiac boy into a warrior shouldering his mission, burning cosmo and continuing the series' passionate tradition with saint cloth battles; the friendship and sacrifice of the new generation of Saints are touching, paying homage to the classics while bringing freshness.

title: 超青春姐弟s
content: This is a short anime depicting the funny daily life of an older sister and younger brother. Centered on the siblings' interactions, the work uses exaggerated gags and life-like jokes to show the subtle relationship between them, from snatching snacks to daily trivia, full of real and hilarious resonance. Presented in short, light episodes with brisk pacing and dense jokes, the contrasting personalities and daily bickering of the siblings are amusing while also conveying the warmth between family members - a sketch-style work perfect for relaxation.

title: 黏黏糊糊!!角质君
content: This is a short gag anime whose protagonist is skin keratin, unfolding various absurd daily life from the keratin's perspective. With exaggerated performances and absurd settings, the work turns the anthropomorphized life of keratin into a delightfully funny show, from daily cleaning to all kinds of bizarre encounters. The extremely fast pace and dense jokes, along with its unique premise and amusing performances, make it a wildly imaginative short anime that lets viewers laugh while forgetting how absurd the premise itself is.

title: 魔鬼恋人
content: "Diabolik Lovers" adapts the same-name otome game. Girl Yui Komori, after transferring to a school inhabited by vampires, is drawn into a blood-sucking game among six brothers. With dark vampire settings, gorgeous characters, and ambiguous interactions as its features, Yui is on edge in her dealings with the dangerous brothers while unable to resist the forbidden temptation. The anime is full of gothic glamour; the brothers have distinct, charming personalities, and the plot wavers between horror and romance, creating a unique dark romantic atmosphere—a representative work of otome vampire romance.

title: 献给某飞行员的恋歌
content: "Toaru Hikuushi e no Koiuta" adapts the same-name light novel. In the holy kingdom of the sky island, the love between boy pilot Kano Balguer and a noble girl sprouts amid class differences and the flames of war. Known for its soaring flight scenes and tragic romantic atmosphere, Kano's determination to protect what matters runs throughout, and his growth from a green youth to a mature pilot is moving. The anime weaves the grandeur of air combat, the bitterness of love, and the cruelty of war, with beautiful music and refined visuals - a youth war romance full of romance and tragedy."

title: 魔法战争
content: "Mahou Sensou" adapts the same-name light novel. After rescuing an unconscious girl late at night, ordinary high schooler Takeshi Nanase discovers he has awakened magic and is drawn into a war among magicians. Set against magic battles and school life, Takeshi faces threats from the Magic Agency and Black Magicians while pursuing the truth, gradually understanding the secret of his own power. The plot is full of mystery and twists, battle scenes are heated, and Takeshi's struggles and choices in the magic war give the work a certain weight beyond its passion.

title: 鬼灯的冷彻
content: "Hozuki no Reitetsu" adapts the same-name manga, telling the hilarious daily life of Hozuki, the chief assistant to the King of Hell. With a cool, sharp-tongued demeanor, Hozuki handles all kinds of hellish affairs, sparring with jailers, goldfish grass, and various troublemaking beings. Blending Japanese hell mythology with modern workplace comedy, the work depicts hell as a bureaucratic institution full of black humor, with dense jokes and brisk pacing. Hozuki's swift, scheming style, the mesmerizing goldfish grass, and cameos by various gods create a uniquely charming ensemble—a comedy gem that viewers can't get enough of.

title: 樱Trick
content: "Sakura Trick" is a yuri-themed daily anime telling the close relationship between two best friends, Haruka Takayama and Yuu Sonoda. The two keep growing closer in high school life, expressing their cherishing of each other through kisses, deepening their bond amid ambiguity and shyness. Known for its warm healing atmosphere and delicate emotional portrayal, the interactions between Haruka and Yuu are full of sweetness; the fresh, bright art style captures the pure yet hazy feelings between girls just right, making it a popular yuri work.

title: 妖怪手表
content: "Yo-kai Watch" is a national-level yokai anime. Boy Keita Amano, able to see yokai through the Yo-kai Watch, solves incidents caused by yokai with companions like the yokai butler Whisper. With lighthearted daily life, cute yokai characters, and collection elements as its features, Keita gradually understands the inner feelings of yokai through adventures and builds friendships with them. The anime is full of childlike fun and imagination; the yokai designs are diverse and adorable, and its all-around tie-ins from games, toys, to anime make it a beloved national IP among children.

title: 未来卡 搭档对战
content: "Future Card Buddyfight" is a card battle anime telling the growth of boy Gao Mikado in card competitions. Fighting alongside his partner buddy monster, Gao keeps challenging strong opponents in Buddyfight tournaments and forms deep friendships with many rivals. With passionate card battles, partner bonds, and orthodox boy-oriented storytelling as its features, the rules and strategy of card battles are rich; Gao hones his skills and grows his spirit through each battle, full of the passion and emotion unique to shonen manga—a familiar classic among card anime fans.

title: 伪恋
content: "Nisekoi" adapts the same-name manga. To maintain peace between their yakuza families, yakuza heir Raku Ichijo and mafia princess Chitoge Kirisaki are forced to pretend to be lovers. As they spend time together, their feelings gradually warm, and the mystery of Raku's first love unfolds. Known for its joyful romantic comedy, complex character relationships, and dramatic plot, Raku wavers among Chitoge, Onodera, and many female characters, with endless misunderstandings and coincidences, dense laughs and high sugar content—a classic among romantic comedy anime.

title: 魔具少女！通
content: "Maken-Ki! Two" is the second season of Maken-Ki!, continuing the school battle and romantic comedy. Boy Takeru Ooyama lives with female friends at Tenbi Academy, fighting over the Maken. This season adds more characters and battle scenes as Takeru's Maken power gradually emerges and duels against strong enemies intensify. Combining fan-service, battle, and harem elements, the work balances lighthearted gags and passionate combat; the interactions between Takeru and the heroines are fun, making it a typical school harem battle series.

title: 妄想学生会＊
content: "Seitokai Yakuindomo*" adapts a yonkoma manga, telling the hilarious daily life of the student council. Council president Shino Amakusa and members engage in various dirty jokes and gags in the student council room, with the work known for rapid-fire dialogue, parody, and adult humor. From council room daily life to school events, the characters say embarrassing things with deadpan expressions, creating a strong sense of contrast, with dense jokes and blazing pace—an enduring classic among gag school anime and widely regarded as the benchmark of late-night comedy.

title: 稻荷恋之歌
content: "Inari, Konkon, Koi Iroha" adapts the same-name manga. Girl Inari Fushimi gains a transformation ability after helping a fox spirit, but this draws her into entanglements with deities. Set in Kyoto, the work blends shrines, gods, and romance, with Inari wavering between her ability and daily life, depicting a warm story of a girl's growth and first love. Known for its beautiful Kyoto scenery and delicate emotional portrayal, Inari gradually learns to cherish sincerity after gaining power; the fox spirit and god settings are full of Japanese fantasy flavor, making it a gentle, healing work.

title: 世界征服～谋略之星～
content: "World Conquest Zvezda Plot" is an original anime. The evil organization Zvezda plots to conquer the world, and its elite unit members fight against justice heroes. Known for its unique villain perspective and cute character designs, the work blends comedy and seriousness, exploring themes of justice and peace. The cute villain girls plot world conquest with deadpan seriousness, and their duels with heroes are full of contrast and laughter, while the latter half gradually deepens; the contemplation of justice and peace gives the work substance beyond its comedy.

title: 信长之枪
content: "Nobunagun" adapts the same-name manga. A girl with mysterious power, Nobuna Oda, travels between modern times and the past with Warring States generals, fighting enemies threatening the world. Blending Warring States history with sci-fi elements, the work features passionate battles and historical reimagining settings; Nobuna's heroic figure on the battlefield is impressive. The anime reinterprets historical Warring States generals with robot-like future equipment and time-travel settings, wildly imaginative with gorgeous battle scenes—a unique work where history and sci-fi intertwine.

title: BUDDY COMPLEX
content: "Buddy Complex" is an original robot anime. Ordinary high schooler Aoba Watase is unexpectedly drawn into battles in a future world, meeting mecha pilot Hina Yumihara and fighting powerful enemies together. With time-skip, friendship bonds, and passionate robot battles as its features, the partnership between Aoba and Hina is the core, as they come to understand and trust each other through battle. The mecha designs are refined and battle scenes fluid; the plot layers forward around time paradoxes and the sacrifice of companions, making it a solid, moving robot anime.

title: 魔女的使命
content: "Witchcraft Works" adapts the same-name manga. When ordinary boy Ayaka Kagari is attacked by a witch, he is saved by the witch knight Honoka Takamiya, and the two are bound together. As a witch, Ayaka secretly protects Honoka, and the two get caught up in the conflict between witches and knights during school life. Combining battles and romantic comedy, the work creates a strong female protagonist; the contrast between Ayaka's cool, overwhelming power and Honoka's ordinary daily life is impressive, with gorgeous fluid battle scenes and suspenseful plot around the witch-knight opposition—a light yet passionate fantasy work.

title: 野良神
content: "Noragami" adapts the same-name manga. Nameless god Yato wanders the human world, taking odd jobs to earn offering money. After meeting girl Hiyori Iki and his weapon Yukine, he is drawn into the world of gods and yokai. Known for modern mythology, passionate battles, and warm daily life, Yato gradually gains bonds while seeking his own value, growing from a desolate, unworshipped god into a trusted existence. The fight scenes are full of tension, and the interactions between Yato, Hiyori, and Yukine are heartwarming; against a mythological backdrop, the work explores companionship and redemption, making it a highly acclaimed fantasy.

title: WIZARD BARRISTERS〜辩魔士圣知
content: "Wizard Barristers: Benmashi Cecil" is an original anime with magic and courtrooms as its themes. Magical defense lawyer Cecil, as a Barrister, uses magic to defend clients in court while facing various conspiracies in the magical legal world. Blending courtroom debate and magic battles, the work shows Cecil's adventures and growth in the magical legal world; each trial is full of intellectual duels and magical confrontations. With a novel setting that fuses the legal genre with fantasy, Cecil's cool, intelligent image is impressive, and the plot balances rigorous courtroom reasoning with gorgeous magic battles.

title: 超级索尼子
content: "SoniAni: Super Sonico" adapts from the same-name character. Sonico is a college student and lead vocalist of a rock band; the work revolves around her daily life, recording her time with band members and family. With healing daily life and music elements as its features, the anime shows Sonico's pure, adorable personality and laid-back life, from practice, performances, to days with her cat, all full of warmth. Without intense conflict, it presents an ordinary yet sparkling daily life of a girl at a slow pace; Sonico's soft image and gentle soundtrack let viewers feel relaxed and healed.

title: 农林
content: "Nourin" adapts the same-name light novel. Agriculture high school student Kosaku Hata and classmates like Ringo Kinoshita engage in hilarious daily life at school. Set against an agriculture background, the work is full of gags, parody, and fan-service, playing with everything from farming knowledge to school life; the romance line between Kosaku and Ringo is woven in. With brisk pacing and dense jokes, the work turns the seemingly serious theme of agriculture into a delightfully funny show; the scenes of characters earnestly discussing farming and livestock are hilarious, making it a unique school comedy with both comedy and passion.

title: 中二病也要谈恋爱！恋
content: "Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! Ren" is the second season of the anime. After entering high school, Rikka Takanashi and Yuuta Togashi continue their chunibyo and romance daily life. This season Rikka's real problems gradually surface, and the couple's feelings deepen amid laughter and fluctuations; the arcs about Rikka's sister and her past are moving. Known for delicate emotions, joyful daily life, and Kyoto Animation's superb production, Rikka's cute chunibyo antics and Yuuta's gags complement each other; beyond the comedy, it also shows the chunibyo girl facing reality and growing, making it a joyful yet heartwarming romantic comedy.

title: 未确认进行式
content: "Engaged to the Unidentified" adapts the same-name manga. Girl Kobeni Yonomori, through her sister's arrangement, begins living with her fiancé Hakuya Mitsumine, who turns out to be an existence with an unmentionable secret. The work revolves around the daily life of Kobeni, Hakuya, and his younger sister, blending romance and fantasy elements and depicting a girl's growth in a light, warm atmosphere. With refined animation, the contrast between Kobeni's wariness and curiosity toward her fiancé and Hakuya's mysterious gentleness is amusing; the daily interactions are full of charm and laughs, making it a healing romantic slice-of-life series.

title: 最近，妹妹的样子有点怪？
content: "Recently, My Sister Is Unusual" adapts the same-name manga. Between boy Mitsuki Kanzaki and his sister Hiyori, a chaotic daily life unfolds due to possession by a ghost girl. Hiyori is possessed by a ghost girl and, to fulfill her wish, engages in various embarrassing contacts with Mitsuki; the work is characterized by borderline comedy. Mitsuki and Hiyori gradually face their inner feelings amid laughable events, and the plot wavers between comedy and warmth; the interactions of the siblings are full of contrast and laughs—a light school comedy with fan-service elements.

title: STRANGE+
content: "STRANGE+" is a short gag anime telling the absurd daily life of detective agency members. Detective Kyou and his assistants handle all kinds of bizarre requests; the work is known for rapid-fire gags, parody, and wildly imaginative plots, delivering dense jokes within extremely short episodes. The oddballs in the detective agency earnestly cause various blunders; the cases themselves are not the point—the focus is on the hilarious interactions of the characters, with blazing pace and dense jokes, making it a stress-relieving short anime.

title: Z/X IGNITION
content: "Z/X IGNITION" is a card game adaptation anime, telling of battles between boys and the otherworldly beings called Z/X. Protagonist Asuka Tennoji, amid the crisis of parallel world invasion, fights with companions to protect Earth, summoning Z/X through cards to battle. With card summoning, passionate battles, and multi-threaded storytelling as its features, Asuka grows through battles against various opponents, gradually understanding the truth of Z/X and parallel worlds. The anime combines card settings with shonen passion, with gorgeous battle scenes, suitable for fans of cards and fantasy.

title: 愚者信长
content: "Nobunaga the Fool" adapts the same-name manga. In an era where science and magic coexist, Warring States lord Oda Nobunaga challenges fate with extraordinary actions. Blending historical figures with sci-fi settings, the work depicts Nobunaga's boldness and radicalism, full of passion and reversals. Unifying the warring states with a vision beyond his era and iron-fisted means, his relationships with Akechi Mitsuhide, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and others are full of tension; the anime's battle scenes are gorgeous and pacing brisk, interweaving history and fantasy to create a uniquely charming alternate Nobunaga.

title: 天才麻将少女 全国篇
content: "Saki: Zenkoku-hen" is the second season of the Saki mahjong anime. Miyanaga Saki and mahjong masters from schools nationwide clash in team battles; this season focuses on the fierce competition of the national tournament. With superpowered mahjong skills, intense matches, and the girls' growth as the main line, Saki and her companions charge toward the national tournament, with every match against strong schools tense and thrilling. The anime turns seemingly dull mahjong matches into passionate battles; mahjong genius girls with distinctive personalities appear one after another, making it a unique gem in competitive anime.

title: 银之匙 Silver Spoon 第二季
content: "Silver Spoon" Season 2 adapts Hiromu Arakawa's same-name manga, continuing the growth of city boy Yugo Hachiken at Ooezo Agricultural High School. Through living day and night with pigs, horses, and cattle, he gradually understands the weight of life and the hardship of agriculture while finding his own direction. This season revolves around internships, Koshien, and graduation choices, portraying the bittersweet reality of rural life with humor and realism while exploring profound themes of dreams vs. reality and the dignity of life. Continuing Arakawa's solid storytelling, the work contains genuine emotion in plain stories, making viewers reconsider the meaning of life.

title: Wake Up, Girls!
content: "Wake Up, Girls!" is an idol anime telling the story of seven girls forming the idol group Wake Up, Girls! at a small entertainment agency in Sendai, Tohoku. Facing the agency's bankruptcy crisis, the girls participate in idol activities with effort and passion in a down-and-out environment, growing step by step amid laughter and tears. Known for its realistic and somewhat cruel portrayal of the idol industry, the work confronts both the glamour and shadows of the idol world; the girls' real struggles, dreams, and friendships intertwine, and the ending's growth and farewell are moving, making it a unique realist work among idol anime.

title: 摸索吧！部活剧 再来一个
content: This is the second season of the experimental short anime where girls seek club activity directions through improvisational dialogue. This season adds new characters; the protagonists keep creating laughs amid absurd club ideas and improvisation. Known for breaking conventional narrative, rapid-fire gags, and parody of anime production, the work cleverly combines the gags of the production process with the characters' self-deprecation - a gag short full of meme spirit, extremely fast-paced with dense jokes, suitable for light viewing.

title: 上课小动作
content: "Tonari no Seki-kun" adapts the same-name manga, telling of the boy Seki sitting in the back of class who never pays attention in lessons, indulging in all kinds of astonishing miniature games, from origami and shogi to homemade game machines. His deskmate Yokoi watches throughout, unable to stop commenting yet often impressed by Seki's creativity. With short, compact episodes, a unique perspective, and delicate portrayal, the work shows an alternative kind of classroom fun; Seki's wild imagination and focus are astonishing, full of both childlike play and creativity—a light, fun school short drama.

title: 属性同好会
content: "D-Frag!" adapts the same-name manga, telling the hilarious daily life of girls in a game creation club. After joining the game creation department, club president Kenji Kazama deals with members of distinct personalities, causing countless jokes from character design to game programming. Known for rapid-fire gags, parody, and absurd comedy, the work turns the chaos of game development into a delightfully funny show; the scenes of members earnestly doing absurd things are hilarious, and beyond the comedy it also shows the young people's love and persistence for games.

title: 滨虎
content: "Hamatora" adapts the same-name manga, telling the story of holders of the superpower called Minimum. Detective Nice and his partner Murasaki run a detective agency in Yokohama, handling cases related to Minimum. As investigations deepen, they are drawn into an organization's conspiracy around superhumans and forced to face the past. With episodic cases and a main plot intertwined, the work blends mystery, battles, and urban suspense; the contrast between Nice's confidence and Murasaki's calm depth, along with Yokohama's cityscape and the undercurrent of intrigue, makes it a distinctive urban suspense work.

title: GO!GO!575
content: "GO!GO!575" is a short anime themed around waka poetry, telling of two high school girls composing poems in the 5-7-5 syllable rhythm. The work combines traditional Japanese waka with modern school life; the girls express their feelings in 5-7-5 form through chats and interactions, turning everything from daily trivia to youthful worries into verse. With a fresh art style, brisk pacing, and a rich Japanese cultural atmosphere, the work skillfully blends tradition and modernity, showcasing the charm of waka in a lighthearted setting—a distinctive cultural sketch.

title: 大家集合！Falcom学园
content: "Minna Atsumare! Falcom Gakuen" is a parody anime of Falcom game characters, placing numerous classic characters from the Trails and Ys series into a fictional school where they live together. The characters cause jokes contrasting with their original settings, full of gags and homages to Falcom's own works. Known for rapid-fire gags and dense easter eggs, popular characters from Rean and Estelle to Adol appear in Q-version form with hilarious interactions; it is a must-see gag anime for Falcom fans, while general viewers can also enjoy it.

title: pupa
content: "Pupa" adapts the same-name manga, telling a dark story between siblings. After his younger sister Yume is attacked by a monster, boy Yotaro also turns into a monster and begins devouring humans to save her. Known for its oppressive, dark tone, cruel plot, and taboo sibling relationship, the work became a talking point for being excessively bloody and dark. The anime's narration is cold, unfolding the siblings' dependence and madness in dire straits; the almost despairing bond is unsettling, making it a highly controversial, extreme dark work.

title: 游戏王ARC-V
content: "Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V" is the fifth installment of the Yu-Gi-Oh! series, telling of dimensional duels using fusion-style summoning. Protagonist Yuya, with the ideal of entertainment dueling, embarks on adventures in Maiami City featuring Action Duels, meeting duelists from other dimensions. With card battles, cross-dimensional plot, and Action Duels as its features, Yuya grows through duels, gradually uncovering the truth of the dimensional war. The anime combines classic Yu-Gi-Oh! passionate duels with novel Action Duel mechanics; card summoning performances are gorgeous, making it an ambitious work in terms of plot settings in the series.

title: 尽管如此世界依然美丽
content: "Soredemo Sekai wa Utsukushii" adapts the same-name shoujo manga. Nika, the fourth princess of the Rain Kingdom who can summon wind and rain, marries far away to the Sun King Livius of the Sunshine Kingdom for political alliance. The two grow closer amid differences and conflict; Nika's innocence and songs heal the king, unfolding a fantasy romance between a princess and a king. Known for its romantic atmosphere, ability settings, and moving music, the contrast between Nika's optimism and strength and Livius's domineering yet gentle nature is charming; the interactions are full of sweetness, and the soundtrack is beautiful—a fantasy romance full of a girl's heart.

title: Lady 宝石宠物
content: "Lady Jewelpet" is an anime in the Jewelpet series, telling of friendship and magical adventures between girls and Jewelpets. Protagonist Lili and the Jewelpets engage in various activities at school and in the world, collecting jewels and helping others. With cute characters, magical transformations, and girls-oriented daily life as its features, the work conveys themes of friendship and dreams; the Jewelpets have adorable designs and distinct personalities, and Lili's adventures with her friends are full of warmth and childlike fun—a healing magical daily anime suitable for girl viewers.

title: Happiness Charge 光之美少女！
content: "Happiness Charge Pretty Cure!" is the 11th installment of the Pretty Cure series. With the wish to make everyone happy, girl Megumi Aino and three others transform into Pretty Cure, fighting to protect the power of hearts in the world. Combining cute transformations, sweet daily life, and passionate battles, the four protagonists have distinct personalities and support each other, showing the girls' growth and bonds. The anime continues the series' transformation magic and daily joy while exploring the meaning of happiness in battle; the teamwork and self-overcoming of the Pretty Cure are moving, making it a representative girls' magical girl anime.

title: 金色琴弦 Blue♪Sky
content: "La Corda d'Oro Blue♪Sky" is an anime in the La Corda d'Oro series, telling of students in the music department of Seisou Academy. Protagonist Kanade Kohinata, after entering the music department, plays with the boys of the orchestra club, deepening understanding through music. Centered on classical music, the work unfolds around ensemble performances, competitions, and youthful romance, full of an elegant musical atmosphere. The classical pieces played and the characters' emotions intertwine; Kanade and the talented boys spark with each other through music, with refined visuals and moving accompaniment—a romance anime full of artistic atmosphere.

title: 艾斯卡与罗吉的工作室～黄昏之空的炼金术士～
content: "Escha & Logy no Atelier" adapts the same-name game, telling the daily life and adventures of alchemists. Boy Logy and girl Escha study alchemy at a remote workshop, experimenting and exploring to save a polluted world. Continuing the Atelier series' warm atmosphere, the work features alchemy, daily life, and adventure, showing two youths growing in a twilight world. The anime retains the game's alchemy synthesis, gathering, and friendship elements; Logy and Escha come to understand each other through shared research, with gentle music and warm visuals—a healing fantasy daily work.

title: 剑灵
content: "Blade & Soul" adapts the same-name online game, telling the adventures of Ahn Jin-hyeol and companions in the Blade & Soul world. In a world where girls coexist with demons, battles unfold around power and vengeance. Known for gorgeous action, martial arts elements, and Eastern fantasy style, the characters seek their own paths between revenge and redemption. The anime's fight scenes are fluid and gorgeous, blending Eastern martial arts with fantasy elements; the grudges and loves of Hongmoon disciples run throughout, with a vast worldview and dramatic character fates—a work of considerable quality among game adaptations.

title: 希德尼娅的骑士
content: "Knights of Sidonia" adapts the same-name manga, telling a sci-fi story of humanity drifting in space, piloting mechs called Gardes to fight the mysterious beings called Gauna. Boy Nagate Tanikaze grows aboard the Sidonia, gradually uncovering the secret of the Gauna and humanity's hope for survival. Known for 3DCG expression, hardcore sci-fi settings, and grand cosmic battles, the fleet life, close combat, and layered suspense are fascinating; the bonds between Nagate and Hoshijiro are precious amid brutal battles, making it a representative hard sci-fi anime.

title: 恶魔之谜
content: "Riddle Story of Devil" is an original anime telling the story of ten girls in an assassin class at a special academy and their target, girl Ichinose Haru. All students aim to assassinate Haru, but student Azuma Tokaku gradually develops a desire to protect her. Known for tense atmosphere, yuri elements, and layered suspense, the girls each harbor secrets and pasts; the game of assassination and protection is gripping, and the bond between Tokaku and Haru deepens amid the clash of blades, with a memorable ending twist.

title: 我们大家的河合庄
content: "Bokura wa Minna Kawai-sou" adapts the same-name manga, telling of high schooler Usa Kazunari's boarding life at Kawai-sou. There he meets the literary girl Ritsu Kawai, and the two gradually grow closer amid daily life at the boarding house and the company of various tenants. Known for its warm healing daily life, delicate romance, and unique art style, the tenants of Kawai-sou have distinct, hilarious personalities; Usa and Ritsu slowly draw near through clumsy interactions, capturing the heartbeat and shyness of adolescence just right—a gentle healing romance slice-of-life series.

title: 美妙旋律 All Star Selection
content: "Pretty Rhythm: All Star Selection" is a compilation anime of the Pretty Rhythm series, bringing together characters from previous installments to review their shining stages from new perspectives. Centered on dance, fashion, and idol dreams, the work integrates classic scenes, presenting a special retrospective and tribute for fans. The anime connects the stages and stories of successive heroines, showing their respective growth and transformation; the song-and-dance scenes are gorgeous and moving, letting old fans relive the emotion while new viewers can also feel the charm of the Pretty Rhythm series.

title: 魔神之骨
content: This is Bandai's original anime telling of boy Yu receiving the power of the Dragon Bone, fighting with companions against the dragon clan threatening Earth. With card and toy tie-ins as its features, Yu keeps growing stronger in battle and forms deep bonds with companions protecting the world - a typical boy-oriented passionate anime. The anime revolves around summoning and fighting dragons; the duels between Yu and the dragon gods are full of passion, and the characters grow toward the shared goal of protecting Earth with brisk pacing, full of the struggle and friendship unique to shonen manga, suitable for children and young viewers.

title: 噬魂师NOT！
content: "Soul Eater Not!" is a spin-off of Soul Eater, telling the daily life of girls at Death Weapon Meister Academy who are not suited for intense combat. The trio studies the way of meister and weapon in a lighthearted atmosphere. Retaining the original's worldview and characters, the work focuses more on daily life and friendship with a cute art style. Girls like Tsugumi Harudori make friends at the academy and experience the joy of growth; though lacking the original's passionate battles, it adds warm daily flavor—an ideal choice for viewers who prefer a light atmosphere.

title: 魔法科高校的劣等生
