content: "The Irregular at Magic High School" adapts the same-name light novel. At a school where magic is treated as technology, siblings Shiba Tatsuya and Shiba Miyuki are evaluated as the Irregular and the Elite respectively, yet Tatsuya hides power surpassing everyone. Set against sibling relations, magic academy, and political struggles, the work revolves around Tatsuya's mystery and overwhelming strength—a typical light-novel academy battle series. Tatsuya reveals his power through a series of conspiracies and battles; Miyuki's admiration and protection of her brother are moving; the battle scenes are gorgeous and settings meticulous, making it a classic among light novel adaptations.

title: JOJO的奇妙冒险 星尘斗士
content: "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders" is the third part of the series, telling of Jotaro Kujo and his grandfather Joseph and others journeying to Egypt to save his mother, waging fierce battles against DIO and his Stand users. Introducing the Stand system, the work is full of intelligence battles and passion; companions appear one by one on the journey, forming a classic team. Stand abilities like Jotaro's Star Platinum and Kakyoin's Hierophant Green each have distinct traits, with every battle full of calculation and reversals; the final showdown with DIO is a historic classic, making this the most representative arc of the JoJo series.

title: 魔法少女大战
content: "Mahou Shoujo Taisen" is an original anime gathering anthropomorphized magical girls of Japan's prefectures. Girls from different regions fight as magical girls; the work intersperses local customs amid fantasy battles. Presented in short episodes with independent stories of multiple girls, it carries local promotional overtones; each magical girl corresponds to a prefecture with unique design and weapons. The work combines idols, local culture, and magical girl themes with a light, bright style, showcasing Japan's regional charms while depicting battles—a highly creative work.

title: 约会大作战 第二季
content: "Date A Live" Season 2 adapts the same-name light novel, continuing the story of Shido Itsuka saving spirits through dates. Facing new spirits such as Kurumi Tokisaki, Shido seals their powers by raising affinity through dating. The work is known for romantic comedy, battles, and gap moe; Shido faces more danger while saving spirits. Kurumi's appearance adds many highlights this season, the spirits have distinct charming personalities, Shido juggles dates and battles, and the anime balances fan-service with passion—a classic light-novel harem battle series.

title: 棺姬嘉依卡
content: "Chaika: Coffin Princess" adapts the same-name light novel. After the war ends, scavenger boy Tooru and his sister Akari meet the coffin girl Chaika on their travels, and the three set out to find Chaika's legacy. The work features fantasy adventure, the mysterious Chaika, and passionate battles; Tooru's group gradually uncovers the truth left behind by the empire. Chaika's coffin secrets, the various factions encountered, and the bond between the siblings intertwine, and the anime's adventurous atmosphere and fluid battle scenes make it a work full of mystery and passion.

title: 风云维新大将军
content: "Fuuun Ishin Dai Shogun" is a short gag anime set during the arrival of the Black Ships in the Edo period. To counter the technological gap, Shogun Tokugawa decides to have beautiful girls pilot giant robots, causing hilarious events. The work features historical parody, robots, and comedy, full of exaggerated performances that turn solemn late-Edo history into absurd robot battles. The contrast of girls piloting giant mechs is adorable, and the anime's brisk pacing and dense jokes show unique creativity while parodying history—a stress-relieving comedy short.

title: 漆黑的子弹
content: "Black Bullet" adapts the same-name light novel. In a world infected by Gastrea, cursed children possess the power to fight the Gastrea. Boy Rentaro Satomi and his partner Enju Aihara, as civil officers, gradually touch the conspiracy behind the world while fighting Gastrea. The work features post-apocalyptic battles, tragic survival themes, and bonds between partners; Rentaro and Enju depend on each other in a cruel world, and society's discrimination and redemption toward the cursed intertwine. The anime's brutal battle scenes and heavy atmosphere make it a work full of despair and hope.

title: 目隐都市的演绎者
content: "Mekakucity Actors" adapts from the Kagerou Project, telling of boy Shintaro meeting the mysterious group Mekakushi-dan. Boys and girls with special abilities are drawn into various incidents; the work is known for multi-line narration, fragmented timelines, and unique direction, unfolding around each character's past and the core secrets of the Mekakushi-dan layer by layer. The anime brings the Kagerou Project's songs and worldview to life; the girls' abilities and tragic pasts are moving, and the ending's timeline convergence is stunning, making it a classic case of multimedia project adaptation.

title: 虫师 续章
content: "Mushishi: Zoku Shou" is the sequel to the Mushishi anime. In a world where humans and mushi coexist, Ginko, a mushi master who can see them, continues traveling to help people troubled by mushi. The work unfolds in episodic format, each episode telling a poignant story related to mushi, known for its tranquil style, profound philosophy, and beautiful visuals. Ginko intervenes as a bystander in events about life, obsession, and nature; the mushi settings symbolize human nature and natural laws. The anime's quiet, far-reaching atmosphere and ethereal soundtrack make it a philosophical work worth savoring repeatedly.

title: 极黑的布伦希尔德
content: "Brynhildr in the Darkness" adapts the same-name manga. After his childhood friend is foretold to die, boy Murakami Ryouta meets the transfer student Kuroha Neko, who claims to be a magician. Neko and her companions escaped from a research institute and hide secrets that could cost them their lives at any moment. The work is known for dark fantasy, tense plot, and tragic fate; the magician girls' life countdown and the institute's conspiracy intertwine, and the feelings between Ryouta and Neko become precious amid despair. The anime's oppressive atmosphere and heart-wrenching plot with a powerful ending make it a work hard to let go of.

title: 选择感染者WIXOSS
content: "selector infected WIXOSS" is a card game adaptation anime telling the dark story of girls participating in WIXOSS card battles. Girls who become selectors fulfill their wishes through battles but are gradually drawn into cruel rules and conspiracies. The work is known for its starkly contrasting dark plot, psychological games, and reversals—a seemingly idol-oriented yet heavy work. The girls' obsessions with wishes, the tragic fate of selectors, and the struggles of figures like Ruuko intertwine; the anime combines card battles with psychological horror, and the ending's reversal is memorable, making it an unconventional masterpiece in card anime.

title: 地球队长
content: "Captain Earth" is a BONES original robot anime. High schooler Daichi Manatsu, after meeting a mysterious girl and a giant robot, becomes a member of Earth's team and fights cosmic enemies with his companions. The work combines fresh youthful daily life with passionate robot battles, exploring friendship, growth, and protection. Daichi's growth and the team's cooperation are infectious; the anime's unique mech designs and fluid battles, along with the boys' and girls' youthful troubles amid passion, make it an original work with both heat and warmth.

title: Love Live! 第二季
content: "Love Live! School Idol Project" Season 2 continues the first season, telling of the growth of Otonokizaka Academy's idol group mus. In a school facing closure, the nine-girl idol group keeps working hard; this season they challenge the Love Live competition and make choices between dreams and reality. The work is known for moving songs, passionate dream-chasing stories, and delicate character portrayal; the members' individual storylines and the group's bonds intertwine, and the concert scenes are grand and moving. As a benchmark idol anime, Love Live! moved countless viewers with its songs and dreams.

title: 一周的朋友。
content: "One Week Friends" adapts the same-name manga. Girl Kaori Fujimiya suffers from a condition that only lets her remember friends for a week, so she forgets them every week. Boy Yuki Hase insists on becoming her friend anew each week, and the two accumulate precious feelings through repeated meetings. The work is known for delicate emotion, gentle narration, and a faint sadness; Kaori's loneliness and Hase's persistence are heartbreaking, and the two carefully protect each other within limited memories. The anime's warm visuals and moving soundtrack capture the purity and helplessness of youth just right—a tearjerking healing work.

title: 众神的恶作剧
content: "Kamigami no Asobi" is an otome game adaptation anime telling the campus romance between a heroine and the gods of myth. Girl Yui Kusanagi enters a school gathering the gods of Japanese, Greek, and Norse mythology, interacting with gods of varied personalities. The work features gorgeous characters, mythological settings, and romance; the gods show cute sides different from legend in the school, and Yui's interactions with each god are romantic. The anime's refined character designs and star-studded voice cast, with a strong otome romantic atmosphere, make it a work aimed at female viewers.

title: 星刻的龙骑士
content: "Dragonar Academy" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Ash is mocked as a failure at the dragon knight academy due to his aptitude, yet accidentally contracts with the strongest dragon girl Eco. The work features dragon knight academy, battles, and romantic comedy; the interactions between Ash and Eco are a highlight. Eco's shift from tsundere to dependence and Ash's rise in dragon knight competitions are fun; the anime's gorgeous battles and novel academy and dragon knight settings make it a light, enjoyable fantasy romance battle series.

title: 如果她的旗帜被折断了
content: "If Her Flag Breaks" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Souta Hatate has the ability to see and break the flags above people's heads, so he deliberately keeps his distance but keeps getting drawn into trouble. The work features romantic comedy, supernatural settings, and a complex flag system; Souta can see the flags above the female characters around him and break them in his own way. Beneath the romantic comedy shell hides a mystery mainline; the flag setting is creative, and the plot switches between light gags and serious suspense—a distinctive school romance series.

title: 请问您今天要来点兔子吗？
content: "Is the Order a Rabbit?" adapts the same-name manga, telling the daily life of girls at a coffee shop called Rabbit House. Cocoa comes to town and meets Chino and other girls; the work features cute characters, warm daily life, and desserts, with bright healing visuals—a representative moe daily anime. The girls at the coffee shop each have charm points, and everything from making coffee to eating sweets is healing; without intense conflict, the anime shows warm daily life among friends, and the interactions of Cocoa, Chino, and others are full of sweetness—a relaxing healing anime.

title: 游戏人生
content: "No Game No Life" adapts the same-name light novel. In a world that forbids all violence, everything is decided by games. Genius siblings Sora and Shiro, summoned into the game world, challenge various opponents with their minds. The work features high-IQ gambits, a fantasy world, and sibling bonds; Sora and Shiro keep winning with game rules. Their matches are full of calculation and reversals, covering everything from board games to video games; the siblings' synchronicity and strength are astonishing, and the anime's high-tension direction and vivid colors bring out the charm of games and intelligence battles to the fullest.

title: 破刃之剑
content: "Broken Blade" adapts the same-name manga, telling of boy Rygart, who cannot use magic in a world where all humans can use magic except him. He joins the war between the empire and the country, piloting ancient mechs like the Delphine, entangled with his childhood friends. The work features war, friendship, and passionate mech battles; Rygart grows through battles against strong enemies, and the sacrifice and choices war brings are heavy. The anime's realistic mech designs and brutal battle scenes, balancing mech warfare and human emotion, make it a serious robot war work.

title: 健全机斗士
content: "Daimidaler: Prince vs Penguin Empire" adapts the same-name manga. Possessing an unusual body, the protagonist powers a penguin-shaped robot through energy exchange with girls. The work features frank fan-service comedy and robot battles; the protagonist saves the world while complaining, a work combining parody and fan-service. The anime combines adult jokes with passionate mech combat, the contrast of piloting a penguin mech is adorable, battle scenes are exaggerated and bold, and pacing is brisk with dense jokes—a parody-focused, hilarious mech comedy.

title: 排球少年
content: "Haikyu!!" adapts Haruichi Furudate's same-name manga. Inspired by the Little Giant, boy Shoyo Hinata falls in love with volleyball, joins Karasuno High's volleyball club, and teams up with genius setter Tobio Kageyama. The work is known for realistic, detailed volleyball portrayal, passionate matches, and team growth; Karasuno's whole team fights to reach nationals, with immense appeal. Hinata and Kageyama's growth from clashing to seamless coordination is thrilling, every match is full of tactics and passion, and the characters' effort and bonds are genuinely moving—universally recognized as a classic sports anime.

title: 金田一少年事件簿R
content: "Kindaichi Case Files R" is a series of the classic mystery anime, telling of genius high school detective Hajime Kindaichi solving various difficult cases. With reasoning talent similar to his grandfather's, Kindaichi untangles classic puzzles of locked rooms and alibis. The work is known for orthodox mysteries, complex case design, and tense plot; each case is ingeniously designed and logically rigorous, with often unexpected culprits. Kindaichi's sympathy when solving cases and his insight into human darkness give the work depth beyond mystery, making it a representative of Japanese orthodox mystery anime.

title: 相扑力士松太郎
content: This is a sumo anime following the legend of sumo wrestler Matsutarou. Possessing innate monstrous strength, Matsutarou rises in the sumo world but repeatedly causes trouble with his impulsiveness and willfulness. The work is known for realistic sumo depiction and character growth, showing the wrestlers' sweat and passion. Matsutarou's journey from a reckless boy to a wrestler standing on his own is full of tension; sumo match scenes are imposing, and the master-disciple bond and rivalries are portrayed delicately—a work full of power and emotion.

title: 妖精的尾巴 第二季
content: "Fairy Tail" Season 2 continues the first season, telling the adventures of the members of the mage guild Fairy Tail. This season, Natsu, Lucy, and friends face new strong enemies like Tartaros, drawn into major events around the magic world. The work is known for passionate battles, bonds between partners, and a grand magic world, full of explosive energy and emotion. The deep camaraderie among Fairy Tail members and Natsu's never-give-up passion are infectious; battle scenes are gorgeous and stunning, and the plot rises and falls between laughter and tears—a classic of passionate fantasy anime.

title: 监督不行届
content: This entry adapts the autobiographical manga by the manga artist, telling the hilarious daily life between the manga artist and her husband, also a manga artist. The work depicts the trivialities and funny moments of married life with self-deprecation, voiced by a real married couple, full of realism and laughs. From deadline hell to daily trivia, the couple's life together is full of warmth and gags; presented in short episodes with brisk pacing, the anime lets viewers smile knowingly and feel the happiness and truth of ordinary married life.

title: M3～黑色之钢～
content: "M3: Sono Kuroki Hagane" is an original anime telling of boys and girls piloting mechs to fight the existence known as the Arch. Protagonist Izamu and companions gradually uncover the truth about their identities and the world through battle. The work features a gloomy atmosphere, psychological portrayal, and sci-fi battles, with a somewhat oppressive style. The youths bear immense psychological pressure in brutal battles, and their fight against the Arch constantly tests their will; the anime's dark tones and heavy plot explore fear and growth in the face of unknown threats—a distinctive work.

title: 乒乓
content: "Ping Pong the Animation" adapts Taiyo Matsumoto's same-name manga, telling the growth of geniuses Makoto Tsukimoto and Yutaka Hoshino in the world of table tennis. The two clash on the table; the work is known for its unique art style, high-speed table tennis portrayal, and profound character psychology, exploring talent, passion, and life choices. From prodigy to confusion to rebirth, the growth trajectories of Hoshino and Tsukimoto are real and cruel; the anime's direction is highly impactful, expressing the speed and passion of table tennis to the fullest—a work of high artistic value among sports anime.

title: 龙珠改 魔人布欧篇
content: "Dragon Ball Kai: Majin Buu Saga" is a Dragon Ball anime telling the final battle between Goku's group and Majin Buu. Facing the strongest enemy with infinite regeneration, Goku, Vegeta, and friends go through life and death, finally ending the war with the Spirit Bomb. The work features classic passionate battles and the fate of Earth; it is the remastered version of the Dragon Ball Z Majin Buu saga. From Saiyan transformations to the appearance of the Supreme Kais, every battle of Goku's group against Buu is thrilling; Vegeta's self-destruction, Gohan's awakening, and the final duel between Goku and Buu are full of tension—a classic arc of the Dragon Ball series.

title: 龙娘七七七埋藏的宝藏
content: "Nanana's Buried Treasure" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Jugo Yama, fleeing debt, comes to Nanae Island and meets the bound-spirit girl Nanana, and the two search for the treasure Nanana buried before her death. The work features puzzle adventures, a cute ghost girl, and passionate reasoning; Jugo gets involved in various puzzles and disputes over the treasure hunt. Nanana's airheadedness and Jugo's wit form a fun contrast; the island's treasure legends and power struggles intertwine, and the anime's puzzle-solving process is fun—a light, brisk adventure with a touch of mystery.

title: 网球优等生
content: "Baby Steps" adapts the same-name manga. Serious boy Eiichirou Maruo devotes himself to tennis with study-like focus, improving through scientific training and self-challenge. The work is known for realistic tennis techniques, data analysis, and the protagonist's growth, showing the wisdom and charm of tennis competition. Maruo treats tennis as an academic subject, growing rapidly through data analysis and technique refinement; his duels against opponents of different styles are highlights, the anime's tennis portrayal is detailed and professional, and Maruo's effort and persistence are admirable—a solid sports work.

title: 犬神同学和猫山同学
content: "Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san" is a yuri-themed short anime. Nekoyama, who is dog-like but afraid of dogs, and Inugami, who is cat-like but afraid of cats, carry out their daily life caught between attraction and fear. The work features cute character designs, warm yuri interactions, and a light atmosphere; the two girls waver between contradiction and heartbeat, with interactions full of charm and laughs. The anime's fresh art style captures the raw, hazy feelings between girls just right; though short, it is full of healing—a fresh piece among yuri works.

title: 迷你偶像 2期
content: "Puchimas! Petit Idolmaster" Season 2 is a Q-version short anime of the iM@S series, telling the daily life of miniaturized idols at the 765 Production office. The Q-version idols create laughs with their cuteness and absurd behavior; the work shows another side of the idols in a light comedic style. Classic characters from Haruka, Chihaya to Iori are all Q-versioned, their mini-plays and interactions full of charm; the anime delivers dense jokes within extremely short episodes—a healing little work that iM@S fans shouldn't miss.

title: 元气囝仔
content: "Barakamon" adapts the same-name manga. Young calligrapher Seishuu Handa, after punching an old master, is exiled to a remote island, where he re-understands calligraphy and life through interactions with islanders and children. The work is known for warm healing daily life, growth themes, and the island's simple human warmth; Handa gradually opens up through interactions with the innocent islanders, especially the little girl Naru. The anime combines the artistic pursuit of calligraphy with plain rural life, containing emotion within laughter; Handa's growth and Naru's innocence bring smiles—a heartwarming work.

title: 战国BASARA Judge End
content: "Sengoku Basara: Judge End" is a Sengoku Basara series anime telling the fierce battles of Warring States generals in the contest for the realm. The work features exaggerated character designs and battle scenes; generals like Yukimura Sanada and Masamune Date clash with their own ambitions. The anime brings out the game's gorgeous special moves and character personalities to the fullest; the one-against-a-hundred battlefield performances are full of passion and exaggeration, with the fateful duel between Yukimura and Masamune and Hideyoshi Toyotomi's ambition running throughout—a powerful work among Sengoku anime.

title: 玻璃之唇
content: "Glasslip" is a P.A.WORKS original anime telling the youth story of seven boys and girls meeting in summer. Protagonist Touko Fukami has the ability to see fragments of the future; her feelings with boy Kakeru Okikura and others intertwine over the summer. The work is known for beautiful visuals and delicate emotional atmosphere; Touko's foresight and confusion about love run through the film, and the youths' worries flow with summer. The anime's visuals are full of summer atmosphere, and the interactions between characters are raw and moving—a youth work with strong literary flavor.

title: 黑执事 马戏团篇
content: "Black Butler: Book of Circus" is a Black Butler anime telling of Ciel and the demon butler Sebastian investigating a mysterious circus. Behind the circus hide dark truths related to Ciel's past; the two maneuver amid splendor and conspiracy. The work is known for Gothic style, conspiracies, and the master-servant relationship; the circus's missing children, human experiments, and other dark settings intertwine with the glorious Victorian background. Sebastian's elegance and power and Ciel's revenge obsession are memorable, and the anime's dark atmosphere and gorgeous visuals complement each other.

title: 日本国有铁道公安队
content: "Rail Wars!" adapts the same-name manga, set in a parallel world where railways are nationalized. Girl You Sakura as a member of the railway police force fights to protect railway order and security. The work features railways, uniforms, and action elements; You grows into a qualified police officer through missions. The anime combines railway culture with character growth; action scenes on trains are fun, and the girls' uniforms and railway settings create a unique atmosphere—a light, brisk work.

title: 女神异闻录4 黄金版
content: "Persona 4 The Golden Animation" adapts the same-name game, telling of transfer student Yu Narukami investigating serial murders in a small town. He and his friends enter the world inside the midnight television, awakening their Persona powers. The work combines mystery, Persona battles, and youthful daily life, full of the unique worldview of the Persona series. Yu and his companions face their own hearts while investigating the truth; the awakening of Personas symbolizes the courage to grow, and the anime's urban legend atmosphere and youthful spirit intertwine—an excellent work among game adaptations.

title: 普通女高中生要做当地偶像
content: "Locodol" adapts the same-name manga, telling the promotional story of two ordinary high school girls chosen as local idols. Nanako Usami and Kana Konoe gradually gain popularity through prefecture events; the work features light idol daily life, local promotion, and comedic elements. The two girls aim to promote their hometown, causing various laughs at school festivals and commercial events; the anime combines regional revitalization with the idol theme in a light, warm atmosphere, showing the cute daily life of local idols.

title: 太空丹迪 第二季
content: "Space Dandy" Season 2 is a sci-fi comedy anime directed by Shinichiro Watanabe, telling the adventures of alien hunter Dandy. Dandy and his partners hunt rare aliens in space; the work unfolds in episodic format, blending parody, homage, and wild imagination with a freewheeling style. Each episode is directed by a different director with varied styles, from hard sci-fi to nonsensical comedy; Dandy's laid-back, scattered personality complements the universe's absurd settings—a work full of creativity and fun.

title: 美妙天堂
content: "PriPara" is an idol anime telling of girls entering the miracle-filled idol theme park PriPara. Manaka Laala and her companions perform as idols in the park; the work features gorgeous stages, cute characters, and a light plot, conveying friendship and dreams. Laala meets many idol friends in PriPara, expressing herself through fashion and song and dance; the anime's stage performances are colorful and childlike, the characters have distinct personalities and warm interactions—a popular girls' idol anime.

title: 搞姬日常
content: "Himegoto" is a cross-dressing comedy short. Hime Arikawa is forced by her sister's debt to join the travesty club of the student council and live in girl's clothing. The work features hilarious cross-dressing daily life, fan-service, and parody; Hime causes various jokes in her cross-dressing life in the student council. The anime has brisk pacing and dense jokes; the student council members' interactions are full of parody and fan-service, and Hime's contrast from resisting to getting used to girl's clothing is hilarious—a stress-relieving comedy short.

title: 刀剑神域 第二季
content: "Sword Art Online" Season 2 adapts the same-name light novel, continuing Kirito's VR world adventures. This season includes the Phantom Bullet arc, where Kirito enters a gun-based world under a pseudonym to investigate deaths, meeting sniper Sinon. The work is known for VRMMO settings, tense battles, and character growth; Kirito's gunfights in GGO are thrilling, and Sinon's growth out of the shadows is moving. The anime weaves virtual and reality, exploring VR's impact on the human mind—an important arc of the Sword Art Online series.

title: 机动战士高达桑
content: "Mobile Suit Gundam-san" is a parody anime of the Gundam series, Q-versioning Gundam characters and unfolding funny daily life. The work features exaggerated performances and Gundam-gag commentary, showing the characters' joyful side away from the battlefield. Classic characters like Amuro and Char are all Q-versioned; their hilarious interactions in daily life are full of homage and gags to the original. The anime has brisk pacing and dense jokes—a light gag work Gundam fans shouldn't miss, and general viewers can enjoy it too.

title: Fate/kaleid liner 魔法少女☆伊莉雅 2wei!
content: "Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya 2wei!" is a spin-off anime of the Fate series, telling of Illya and Miyu becoming magical girls to collect cards. This season adds more characters and battles; Illya faces new enemies after becoming a magical girl. The work features magical girl transformations, Fate worldview, and daily comedy, combining Fate's serious settings with the light magical girl atmosphere; Illya's cuteness and gorgeous battles complement each other, and the anime balances fan-service and passion—a uniquely styled work in the Fate series.

title: LOVE STAGE!!
content: "LOVE STAGE!!" is a BL anime telling the romance between the manga-loving boy Izumi Sena from a celebrity family and the popular entertainer Ryoma Ichijou. Izumi gradually opens up under Ryoma's pursuit; the work features light sweet BL romance, comedy, and voice actor gags. From an accidental reunion, Ryoma's passionate pursuit and Izumi's tsundere response are full of laughs and heartbeats; the anime's refined character designs and strong romantic atmosphere, showing the two growing in sweet daily life, make it a popular BL anime.

title: 少年好莱坞
content: "Shonen Hollywood" is an idol anime telling the growth of the boy idol group Shonen Hollywood. The five members use a small Tokyo theater as their stage, chasing the dream of becoming top idols. The work features delicate youth ensemble, music, and dream-chasing stories; the members have distinct personalities and dreams, growing step by step on the small theater stage. The anime portrays the idols' struggles and collision with reality from a realistic perspective, and the songs and stage performances are infectious—an idol anime with considerable literary flavor.

title: 东京ESP
content: "Tokyo ESP" adapts the same-name manga. High school girl Rinka Urushiba, who gained superpowers, and her companions fight those who misuse abilities in the city. The work features superpower battles and a city where justice and chaos coexist, unfolding conflicts among ESP users. Rinka awakens from an ordinary girl into a warrior, gradually learning about the world of ability users and conspiracies with her partners; the anime's fight scenes are gorgeous, the superpower settings diverse, and pacing brisk—a standard superpower battle work.

title: ALDNOAH.ZERO
content: "ALDNOAH.ZERO" is an original robot anime. The war between Mars and Earth erupts due to the overwhelming power of Martian mechs; boy Inaho Kaizuka's wisdom as an ordinary person intertwines with the fate of Martian prince Slaine. The work is known for grand war, intelligence battles, and tragic overtones, with a controversial ending. Inaho counters the overwhelming technological gap with a cool head, and Slaine's struggle between loyalty and ambition is poignant; the anime's refined mech battles and plot full of reversals and shocks make it a highly topical original robot work in recent years.

title: 人生
content: "Jinsei" adapts the same-name light novel. Members of the student counseling department solve school troubles in relay fashion. The work features light comedic daily life, various troubles, and character interactions with a relaxed pace. The members each have distinct personalities, giving various unreliable but funny advice for different troubles; the anime's episodic plot is light and brisk, and the characters' interactions are full of laughs. Beyond the comedy, it also shows students' youthful worries—a school comedy suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: 白银的意志 ARGEVOLLEN
content: "Argevollen" is an original robot anime telling of boys' mech battle stories. Protagonist Tokimune, participating in war piloting a mech, gradually learns the truth about war and peace. The work features sci-fi war, growth, and robot battles; Tokimune's growth on the battlefield and his reflections on war run throughout. The anime's hard mech designs and intense battle scenes, with a plot full of tension around mercenary units and great-power conflicts, make it a solid robot war work.

title: Free!-Eternal Summer-
content: "Free! -Eternal Summer-" is the second season of the swimming anime Free!. Haru, Makoto, Rin, and Sousuke continue chasing dreams in the high school swimming club; this season centers on the national tournament and graduation choices. The work is known for delicate emotion, passionate swimming races, and youthful bonds; Haru's pursuit of freedom, Rin's struggles, and Sousuke's involvement add tension. The anime's underwater animation is beautiful, and the friendship and rivalry among characters are charming—a sports anime combining beauty and passion.

title: 精灵使的剑舞
content: "Blade Dance of Elementalers" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Kamito Kazehaya, in a spirit academy with only female elementalists, becomes the only male elementalist and trains with noble girls. The work features spirit summoning, blade dance battles, and harem elements; Kamito gradually shows his strength in the Blade Dance Festival. The anime's refined character designs and gorgeous battles, with interactions full of fan-service and ambiguity between Kamito and the elementalist girls, and novel academy battle and spirit contract settings, make it a light fantasy harem battle series.

title: 幕末摇滚
content: "Bakumatsu Rock" is a music anime set in the late Edo period, where the Shinsengumi and the anti-shogunate faction clash through rock music. Ryoma Sakamoto and others sing their hearts for change with rock; the work combines historical figures with rock music, full of passion and exaggerated performances. The anime turns the late-Edo patriots into rock bands, expressing ideals and resistance through music; the characters have gorgeous designs and passionate performances, the songs have strong beats, balancing parody and passion—a uniquely styled music anime.

title: 修业魔女璐璐萌
content: This entry adapts the same-name manga, telling the contract comedy between apprentice witch Lulu and a boy. Lulu is punished for violating rules and forms a strange contract with the boy; the two cause various jokes amid magic and daily life. The work features magical girls, comedic daily life, and warm atmosphere; the contrast between Lulu's airheadedness and the boy's gags, with brisk pacing and dense jokes, shows light daily life under the magic setting—a healing yet fun work.

title: 桃剑
content: "Momo Kyun Sword" adapts the same-name light novel. Based on the Momotaro story, girl Momoko inherits the name of Momotaro and fights the demon clan with her companions. The work features Japanese-style fantasy, cute girl battles, and comedy; Momoko's group grows through adventures. The anime reinterprets the Momotaro legend; the adventures of Momoko and her three partners are full of laughter and battle, the Japanese-style scenes and yokai settings create a unique atmosphere, and the characters' interactions are warm and fun—a light, brisk fantasy adventure work.

title: 向山进发 第二季
content: "Encouragement of Climb" Season 2 is the sequel to the mountaineering anime. Girl Aoi Yukimura and childhood friend Hinata Kuraue, along with friends, challenge various mountains in their daily life. This season adds new characters and richer mountaineering scenes; the work is known for healing daily life, beautiful mountain scenery, and the girls' growth. Aoi's gradual love of mountain climbing from a fear of heights, and the girls' laughter and emotion in the mountains, are healing; the anime's scenery art is beautiful, and the interspersed mountaineering knowledge adds both fun and educational value—a warm daily-life work.

title: 青春之旅
content: "Ao Haru Ride" adapts the same-name shoujo manga. Protagonist Futaba Yoshioka regrets that her first love, Kou Mabuchi, transferred in middle school; after reuniting in high school, the two draw close again. The work is known for delicate school romance, adolescence worries, and a faint melancholy; the emotional entanglement between Futaba and Kou is moving. Futaba disguises herself to avoid being ostracized, while Kou becomes cold due to family changes; the two gradually shed their disguises in the process of reknowing each other. The anime depicts a girl's heart and the bitterness of youth to the fullest—a romance work full of resonance.

title: 斩·赤红之瞳！
content: "Akame ga Kill!" adapts the same-name manga. Boy Tatsumi comes to the capital and joins the assassin group Night Raid, working to overthrow the corrupt empire. The work is known for its dark cruel worldview, tragic ending, and intense battles; the characters' fates are ill-fated and shocking. The Night Raid members each hold beliefs and tragic pasts, sacrificing one after another in the battle against the empire; Tatsumi grows amid blood and tears, and the anime's tragic, tearjerking ending makes it an unforgettable dark passionate work.

title: 生存游戏社
content: "Sabagebu! Survival Game Club" adapts the same-name manga. New student Momoka Sonokawa joins the survival game club and participates in survival game battles under the seniors' guidance. The work combines gun battles, comedy, and fan-service; Momoka gradually reveals her talent in games, and the team's interactions are full of laughs. From tactical briefings to practical drills, the club girls win in unexpected ways; the anime has brisk pacing and dense jokes, combining serious survival games with absurd daily life—a light comedy school comedy.

title: 三坪房间的侵略者！？
content: "Invaders of the Rokujouma!?" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Kotaro Satomi, in a cheap three-tatami room, welcomes invaders like a ghost, magical girl, and underground people, unfolding a farce over the room. The work features ensemble comedy, fantasy battles, and harem elements; Kotaro's rent life becomes lively due to various invaders. The ghost Clan, magical girl Theia, and others each have goals, and their interactions with Kotaro are full of laughs; the anime gradually unfolds the characters' backstories amid comedic daily life—a light, fun ensemble comedy.

title: 花物语
content: "Hanamonogatari" is part of the Monogatari series, telling the story between Kanbaru Suruga and the mysterious Numachi Rouka. This work focuses on Kanbaru's high school period, around the entanglement of vampires and the sports club. The work continues the series' unique dialogue style and visual expression; it is a side story of the Monogatari series. Kanbaru's past and inner wounds unfold in detailed narration, and the reunion and farewell with Rouka carry the Mono-no-aware unique to the series; the anime's stylized direction and brilliant dialogue are as excellent as ever.

title: 东京喰种
content: "Tokyo Ghoul" adapts the same-name manga. Ghouls who feed on humans lurk in Tokyo; college student Kaneki Ken is transformed into a half-ghoul after an encounter, struggling between human and ghoul. The work is known for its dark oppressive atmosphere, cruel survival struggle, and psychological portrayal; Kaneki's growth and transformation are memorable. Kaneki moves from a timid youth onto a painful path of growing strong; the hatred and tragic cycle between ghouls and humans run throughout. The anime's visuals are impactful—a representative dark work.

title: STRANGE+ 第二季
content: "STRANGE+" Season 2 continues the first season, continuing the detective agency's absurd daily life. Detective Kyou and his assistants handle various bizarre requests; this season adds more imaginative plots atop the original laughs. The work features rapid-fire gags and parody; the oddballs in the detective agency still handle cases in hilarious ways, the anime's blazing pace and dense jokes present packed comedic bits in extremely short episodes—a light, stress-relieving short anime.

title: 月刊少女野崎君
content: "Monthly Girls' Nozaki-kun" adapts the same-name yonkoma manga. Girl Chiyo Sakura confesses to her crush Umetarou Nozaki, only to discover he is a shoujo manga artist; the two carry out hilarious daily life through manga creation. The work is known for romantic comedy, the shoujo manga creation process, and dense jokes; its anti-trope settings are widely acclaimed. Nozaki's dullness and Chiyo's innocence form gap moe; the various blunders in the manga creation process are hilarious, and the anime plays with shoujo manga tropes—a classic comedy with both laughs and sweetness.

title: 法兰雀丝卡
content: "Francesca" is a regional promotion anime of Fukuoka. Girl Francesca, having lost her memory for some reason, starts a new life in Fukuoka, interacting with local characters. The work is set against Fukuoka's landmarks and specialties, with regional promotion and daily healing overtones. Francesca meets local people on Fukuoka's streets, gradually recovering her memories and self; the anime shows Fukuoka's food, sights, and culture in a light, warm atmosphere—a work with both promotional and healing functions.

title: 东京残响
content: "Terror in Resonance" is an original anime directed by Shinichiro Watanabe. Two boys carry out terrorist attacks in Tokyo, maneuvering against the detective chasing them. The work is known for its tense atmosphere, cold narration, and exploration of social issues, with a calm yet charged style. The two boys' pasts and motives gradually emerge through the investigation; they question society with bomb attacks, and detective Shibazaki's pursuit and the boys' fates intertwine. The anime's soundtrack and visuals are refined—a thought-provoking work.

title: 信长协奏曲
content: "Nobunaga Concerto" adapts the same-name manga, telling of modern high schooler Saburou traveling back to the Warring States period, mistaken for Oda Nobunaga and achieving hegemony in his place. The work is known for historical time-travel, humor, and passion coexisting; Saburou stirs the turbulent era with modern knowledge. Saburou maneuvers with Warring States heroes using modern thinking, and his relationships with Kicho and Hideyoshi are fun; the anime balances historical authenticity with light comedy, and the contrast between Saburou's laid-back kind nature and the cruelty of the era makes it a distinctive Sengoku work.

title: 心理测量者 新编集版
content: "Psycho-Pass" (New Edit ver.) is a re-edited version of Psycho-Pass Season 1, telling of inspector Akane Tsunemori and enforcer Shinya Kogami chasing crimes in a near-future society managed through psychological indices. The work is known for its cyberpunk worldview, philosophical reflection, and tense investigations. In a society where psycho-pass values decide everything, the contrast between Akane's purity and Kogami's struggles, with the duel against genius criminal Shogo Makishima running throughout, is central; the anime's deep exploration of systems, justice, and humanity makes it a classic of sci-fi crime anime.

title: 暗芝居 第二季
content: "Yami Shibai" Season 2 is the sequel to the horror short anime. Using Showa-style paper theater, the work tells various urban legends and ghost stories, each episode centering on a chilling horror tale. The work is known for its nostalgic art style, grotesque plots, and spine-tingling atmosphere. From vengeful spirits and curses to distorted daily life, each story creates a strong sense of horror in just a few minutes, and the paper theater format adds eeriness—a must-see for horror anime fans.

title: 戏剧性谋杀
content: "DRAMAtical Murder" adapts the same-name BL game, telling of boy Aoba in an alternate world drawn into a bloody rally while searching for his memories and the truth. The work features a cyberpunk world, BL elements, and suspense battles; Aoba's relationships with various characters unfold layer by layer. Aoba gradually approaches the truth through interactions with each character; the cruelty of the rally and the city's dark side intertwine. The anime's cold atmosphere and suspenseful plot make it a representative BL game adaptation.

title: REPLY 滨虎
content: "Reply Hamatora" is the second season of Hamatora, continuing Nice and Murasaki's superpowered detective story. This season deepens the conspiracy of the superpowered organization; Nice and Murasaki face the shadows of their past while pursuing the truth. The work combines episodic mysteries with the main suspense; on Yokohama's streets, the entanglements of ability users gradually surface, and the partnership between Nice and Murasaki grows stronger through trials. The anime's calm atmosphere and tight plot make it a solid urban suspense work.

title: 花舞少女
content: "Hanayamata" adapts the same-name manga, telling of introverted girl Naru Sekiya learning Japanese dance and chasing dreams after meeting the American girl Hana. The work is themed on Japanese dance, girls' friendship, and youthful growth, full of energy and healing. Encouraged by Hana, Naru joins the dance club; her growth from shy and introverted to shining on stage is moving, the anime's dance scenes are graceful, and the girls' mutual support is warm—a youth story full of positive energy.

title: 美少女战士Crystal
content: "Sailor Moon Crystal" is a re-made version of Sailor Moon, faithfully following the original manga. Usagi Tsukino awakens as Sailor Moon, fighting the Dark Kingdom with her companions. The work features gorgeous transformations, girl battles, and the original worldview, with an art style closer to the source material. Usagi grows from a clumsy girl into a sailor soldier protecting love and justice; her bonds with Ami, Makoto, and others, and her romance with Mamoru, intertwine. The anime's transformation scenes are gorgeous, and the sailor soldiers' battles are charming—a new-generation work of the classic magical girl series.

title: 火星异种
content: "Terra Formars" adapts the same-name manga. Cockroaches sent to adapt Mars to Earth's environment evolve into giant brutal aliens; humanity dispatches genetically modified warriors to hunt them. The work is known for brutal battles, tragic sacrifices, and sci-fi settings, with tense life-and-death duels throughout. The expedition members each have genetic abilities and suffer attrition in deadly combat against Martian cockroaches; the anime's gore and despairing atmosphere are memorable—a representative hardcore sci-fi battle work.

title: 偶像活动 第三年
content: "Aikatsu!" Season 3 is a sequel to the idol activity series, telling the idol life of girls at Starlight Academy. This season centers on competitions like the Starlight Queen Cup; Ichigo Hoshimiya keeps challenging herself in idol activities. The work is themed on gorgeous stage performances, fashion, and girls chasing dreams; Ichigo and her friends keep growing on the idol path, meeting new rivals. The anime's song-and-dance scenes are gorgeous and characters cute, full of the sparkle and emotion of the idol world—a classic series of girls' idol anime.

title: 山贼的女儿罗妮娅
content: "Ronja, the Robber's Daughter" adapts Swedish children's literature, telling the friendship between the robber's daughter Ronja and Birk, the son of the rival family. Ronja grows up freely in the mountains, forming a deep bond with Birk amid confrontation and understanding. The work is known for natural scenery, fairy-tale atmosphere, and growth themes; Ronja's adventures are full of childlike innocence and courage, and the anime's fresh art style shows the beauty of the Nordic forest to the fullest. The friendship of the two children transcending family feuds is touching—a fairy tale suitable for family viewing.

title: 寄生兽 生命的准则
content: "Parasyte -the maxim-" adapts the same-name manga. High schooler Shinichi Izumi, parasitized on his right hand, is forced to coexist with the parasite, growing while fighting his own kind and reflecting on human society. The work is known for profound philosophical thinking, tense battles, and exploration of the essence of life. Shinichi and the parasite Migi go from confrontation to fighting side by side, gradually changing through battles against other parasites; the anime deeply explores humanity's ecological niche, the cruelty of life, and coexistence—a classic work combining entertainment and thought.

title: 笑对阴天
content: This entry is about three brothers running a prison for executions in Meiji-era Kyoto, drawn into a conspiracy over a cursed sword and the anti-shogunate faction. The work features Japanese-style adventure, brotherly bonds, and yokai battles; the three Hotaru brothers protect justice amid Kyoto's turbulence. The eldest's brightness, the youngest's weakness, and the mysterious nature of the middle brother intertwine as they deal with the cursed sword and late-Edo forces; the anime's Japanese-style atmosphere is rich and battle scenes fluid, with the brothers' bond running throughout—a work full of era flavor.

title: 甘城光辉游乐园
content: "Amagi Brilliant Park" adapts the same-name light novel. High schooler Seiya Kanie is dragged in as the manager of the failing amusement park Amagi, tasked with revitalizing it within a limited time. The work combines management, comedy, and fantasy elements; Seiya struggles in cooperation with the magical world residents. The park's fairy residents each have distinct traits; Seiya solves problems one by one with management smarts and gags. The anime has brisk pacing and dense jokes, showing the team's growth amid comedic daily life—a light, fun work.

title: 高达Reconguista in G
content: "Gundam Reconguista in G" is a Gundam series anime directed by Yoshiyuki Tomino, telling of boy Bellri piloting a Gundam and adventuring with companions in a new era after the Universal Century. The work is known for unique mech designs, a grand worldview, and Tomino-style narration. Bellri, his sister Aida, and the mysterious girl Raraiya are drawn into a conflict over energy and politics; the mech battles have Tomino's characteristic speed, and the plot is jumps yet meaningful—a distinctly styled work of its era.

title: 我，要成为双马尾
content: "Gonna be the Twin-Tail!!" adapts the same-name light novel. High schooler Souji Mitsuka, who loves twintails, transforms into a twintail warrior to fight otherworldly invaders. The work combines transformation, battle, and parody; Souji and his companions protect the love of twintails. Enemies from another world try to eradicate humanity's twintails; Souji and friends fight as twintail warriors. The anime's exaggerated gorgeous battles and wild settings freely switch between passionate combat and comedic gags—a light, enjoyable parody battle series.

title: 早安恋味糕点店
content: This is a short anime telling the daily life of pastry school female students and teachers around desserts. The work features dessert-making, romance elements, and a light atmosphere; the girls develop feelings while learning. The anime combines exquisite desserts with the girls' youth, each episode centering on a dessert, with cute art and a warm atmosphere—a light short work with both food and romance.

title: 结城友奈是勇者
content: "Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru" is an original anime telling the battles of the Yuusha Club girls in the Shinju-sama world against the enemy Vertex. The girls gain power through battle but pay heavy prices. The work is known for the stark contrast between daily life and cruelty, tragic fate, and the girls' bonds, bringing tears. The club girls switch between ordinary daily life and brutal battles; the price of power and sacrifice is heartbreaking, and the anime wavers between healing and despair, with an ending of sacrifice and redemption that is highly impactful—one of the most topical original anime in recent years.

title: 白箱
content: "SHIROBAKO" is a P.A.WORKS original anime telling the workplace story of Aoi Miyamori, a new production assistant at the animation studio Musashino Animation, and her colleagues making anime. The work portrays the front and back stages of anime production realistically, full of respect and love for the industry, with a vivid ensemble of characters. From scripts, storyboards, to animation and voice acting, the anime presents every production stage in detail; Aoi and her colleagues struggle through deadlines, breakdowns, and crises. The workplace ensemble and persistence for dreams are moving—a must-see for anime industry professionals and fans.

title: 我家浴缸的二三事
content: "Orenchi no Furo Jijou" is a short anime telling the cohabitation life of boy Tatsumi and the beautiful merman Wakasa. Wakasa's cheekiness and Tatsumi's tsundere form gap moe; the work features light comedy, daily life, and fan-service. The merman Wakasa refuses to leave Tatsumi's bathtub, and their daily life is full of chaos and warmth; the anime has brisk pacing and dense jokes, showing the strange friendship between humans and other species amid laughter—a stress-relieving short anime.

title: 高达创战者TRY
content: "Gundam Build Fighters Try" is the sequel to Gundam Build Fighters, telling the new story of Sekai Kamiki and friends battling with Gunpla. This season centers on three-on-three team battles; Sekai teams up with Yuuma Kousaka and Fumina Hoshino, growing through the Gunpla Battle tournament. The work features passionate battles and character bonds; the trio's teamwork and personal conflicts intertwine. The anime's battle scenes are gorgeous and full of homage to the Gundam series—a youthful work in the Gundam theme.

title: 天体的秩序
content: "Sora no Method" is an original anime telling the story between girls in the disc-shaped city and the mysterious disc and its power. Naoki Hisaya's plot revolves around wishes and their price; the girls' friendship and the truth of the disc unfold layer by layer, with a gentle yet faintly melancholy atmosphere. The past and present of the seven girls in the disc city intertwine; the price of wishes and the promise of reunion run throughout. The anime's fresh visuals and delicate emotions make it a work full of warmth and feeling.

title: 电器街的漫画店
content: "Denki-gai no Honya-san" adapts the same-name manga, telling the daily life of employees at an electronics district manga shop. Boy Hio and the distinctly quirky employees cause various jokes in their workplace; the work features otaku culture, comedy, and workplace daily life. From restocking and checkout to interactions with otaku customers, the manga shop work is full of ACG gags and laughs, and the employees each have charm points; the anime has brisk pacing and dense gags—a light workplace comedy full of otaku culture.

title: 寻找失去的未来
content: "Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete" adapts the same-name game. A sci-fi romance story in a modern school, where the protagonists return to the past to prevent a future tragedy. The work weaves time travel, mystery, and romance, centered on memories and choices of the future. The protagonists gradually learn the truth about the future while investigating the school's strange events, returning to the past again and again to change fate; the anime's plot layers forward, and the combination of romance and sci-fi is charming—a work with both suspense and emotion.

title: 棺姬嘉依卡 复仇之战
content: "Chaika: Avenging Battle" continues Tooru's group's adventures. This season, the battle over Chaika's legacy fully erupts; Tooru and Chaika are drawn into a grand conspiracy involving the empire, forbidden books, and the dragon tribe. The work features fantasy adventure, passionate battles, and mysteries unfolding layer by layer; Chaika's true identity, the empire's ambition, and the partners' bonds intertwine. The anime's adventurous atmosphere is rich and battle scenes fluid, and Season 2's plot is grander—a work full of mystery and passion.

title: Fate/stay night [Unlimited Blade Works]
content: "Fate/stay night [Unlimited Blade Works]" adapts the same-name game, telling of the Holy Grail War. Magus Shirou Emiya and Servants like Saber and Archer participate in the battle for the Grail; this work centers on the Rin route, focusing on Shirou's ideals and Archer's truth. The work is known for gorgeous battles, a grand worldview, and profound themes; the strong contrast between Shirou's idealism and Archer's disillusionment is central. Produced by ufotable, the battle scenes are industry-leading—a peak work of the Fate series.

title: 虫师 续章 第2部分
content: "Mushishi: Zoku Shou" Part 2 is the second part of the Mushishi sequel; Ginko continues helping people troubled by mushi on his travels. The work unfolds in episodic format, continuing the tranquil style and profound philosophy; each episode is like a short poem about life and nature. Ginko intervenes as a bystander in various events; the mushi settings symbolize human obsession and natural laws. The anime's calm beautiful visuals and ethereal soundtrack contain deep reflection within quiet narration—a philosophical work worth savoring repeatedly.

title: 狼少女与黑王子
content: "Wolf Girl & Black Prince" adapts the same-name manga. Vain girl Erika Shinohara lies about having a boyfriend and is blackmailed by the sadistic Kyouya Sata into playing a fake boyfriend. The two gradually develop real feelings through fake dating; the work features romantic comedy, gap moe, and delicate emotions. The contrast between Erika's disguise and Kyouya's sadism is fun, and their relationship deepens through mutual probing; the anime depicts a girl's conflicted heart and the sweetness of love in detail—a romantic comedy full of heartbeats.

title: CROSS ANGE 天使与龙的轮舞
content: "Cross Ange: Rondo of Angel and Dragon" is an original robot anime. Noble princess Ange awakens as a witch who can pilot mechs, is exiled, joins a prison unit, and fights dragons and societal prejudice. The work is known for its grand worldview, starkly contrasting plot, and passionate battles, with moving character growth. Ange falls from an arrogant princess into a prison unit, then rises again in desperate circumstances; the truth about the dragons and human society's discrimination intertwine. The anime's plot is full of twists and battle scenes gorgeous—a work full of impact.

title: 魔弹之王与战姫
content: "Lord Marksman and Vanadis" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Tigre meets the Vanadis Eleonora in a battle and is drawn into war between great powers. The work features fantasy war, the Vanadis' powers, and romantic adventure; Tigre gradually grows into a hero amid war. Tigre's archery combined with the Vanadis' superhuman power shows bravery and wisdom in the flames of war; the anime's grand war scenes and romantic character interactions make it a fantasy work full of passion and adventure.

title: 选择扩散者WIXOSS
content: "selector spread WIXOSS" is the sequel to selector infected WIXOSS, telling of Ruuko and other girls continuing WIXOSS card battles. This season deeply reveals the fate of selectors and the girls' wishes; the work is known for its dark reversal plot, psychological games, and sense of fate. Ruuko's questioning of WIXOSS's essence in battle and the price behind the girls' wishes intertwine; the anime continues the previous work's dark atmosphere with constant reversals and a stunning ending—a uniquely dark masterpiece in card anime.

title: 晨曦公主
content: "Akatsuki no Yona" adapts the same-name manga. Princess Yona of Kouka, after her father is murdered, flees with her childhood friend Hak, embarking on a journey to find the Four Dragon Warriors and restore the kingdom. The work is known for adventure, growth, and the girl's awakening; Yona gradually grows from a frail princess into a strong woman. Yona hones archery during the flight and gathers companions; her dealings with the Four Dragon Warriors and various factions are adventurous, the anime's fantasy settings and character growth are moving, and Yona's transformation is admirable—a work full of power and warmth.

title: 巴哈姆特之怒 GENESIS
content: "Rage of Bahamut: Genesis" is a fantasy anime produced by Cygames. In a world after the war between gods and demons, the fleeing mage Amira meets bounty hunter Favaro and is drawn into the crisis of Bahamut's revival. The work is known for refined visuals, a grand fantasy worldview, and adventure stories. The interactions between Favaro and Amira during the chase and the undercurrents of gods and demons intertwine; the anime's production quality is extremely high, the worldview vast, and the plot unfolds between adventure and conspiracy—a luxurious work among game adaptations.

title: 灰色的果实
content: "Grisaia no Kajitsu" adapts the same-name game. Boy Yuuji Kazami transfers to an academy with only five girls, gradually learning about each of their pasts. The work is known for its dark atmosphere, psychological portrayal, and healing ending, centered on the girls' wounds and redemption. The five girls each carry heavy pasts; Yuuji also reveals his own secrets in the process of understanding them. The anime's oppressive atmosphere and delicate psychological depiction, with a moving ending of redemption and warmth, make it a work combining darkness and healing.

title: 七大罪
content: "The Seven Deadly Sins" adapts the same-name manga. Princess Elizabeth of the kingdom searches for the legendary knight order Seven Deadly Sins, meeting their leader Meliodas. The work is known for fantasy adventure, passionate battles, and bonds between partners; the Sins each have distinct personalities, and the story unfolds around the kingdom's crisis and Meliodas's past. Meliodas and Elizabeth's bond, the Sins' loyalty, and the kingdom's conspiracies intertwine; the anime's gorgeous battles and grand worldview, full of laughs and warmth beyond passionate combat, make it a classic of fantasy adventure.

title: 魔术快斗1412
content: "Magic Kaito 1412" is an anime of the Phantom Thief Kid series, telling of high schooler Kaito Kuroba inheriting his father's identity as Phantom Thief Kid and conducting magic thefts around the world. The work features gorgeous magic, Kid's dashing performances, and romantic comedy; Kaito pursues the truth about his father. Kaito switches between Phantom Thief Kid and ordinary student; his interactions with Aoko and duels with police are fun, and the anime's magic performances are gorgeous and fluid, showing Kid's gentlemanly charm to the fullest—a dedicated work for the classic character Phantom Thief Kid.

title: 境界触发者
content: "World Trigger" adapts the same-name manga. Otherworldly Neighbors invade Earth; to counter the threat, the domestic organization Border trains combatants. Boy Yuma Kuga and Osamu Mikumo join Border, growing through battle. The work is known for tactical battles, teamwork, and a rigorous worldview; Yuma and Osamu gradually stand out in Border's team battles. The anime's tactical design is rigorous and teamwork portrayal detailed, with many distinct characters—a battle work emphasizing strategy and team coordination.

title: 牙狼 炎之刻印
content: "Garo: Honoo no Kokuin" is a Garo series anime telling of Madou Knights fighting to protect humans from the demons Horrors. Knight Leon carries his father's will, growing amid conspiracies and darkness. The work is known for refined 3DCG, gorgeous battles, and a dark fantasy atmosphere; the bond between Leon and the Golden Knight and battles against Horrors are impressive. The anime's outstanding visuals bring out the armor and monster designs of the Garo series to the fullest, exploring themes of protection and sacrifice within a dark tone—a masterpiece of tokusatsu-derived anime.

title: 银仙
content: "Gugure! Kokkuri-san" adapts the same-name manga. A fox spirit calling himself Kokkuri-san is summoned by the airheaded girl Kohina Ichimatsu and then lives with her, taking care of her daily needs. The work features daily comedy, gags, and a warm atmosphere; the contrast between Kokkuri's fussy caretaker image and the girl's airheadedness is fun. Kokkuri causes various jokes while taking care of Kohina; the anime has brisk pacing and dense jokes, showing the two protagonists' strange bond and warmth beyond the laughter—a light, healing daily work.

title: 飙速宅男 GRANDE ROAD
content: "Yowamushi Pedal: Grande Road" is the second season of Yowamushi Pedal; Sakamichi Onoda and Sohoku High's cycling club continue competing in the high school league. This season centers on the fierce clash with Hakone Academy; the team undergoes trials in climbing, sprinting, and teamwork. The work is known for passionate races and character growth; the mountain battles between Sohoku and Hakone are thrilling, and Onoda's climbing ability and teammates' coordination make viewers' blood boil. The anime depicts road cycling races in meticulous detail—a sports anime that keeps viewers holding their breath.

title: 心理测量者2
content: "Psycho-Pass 2" is the second season of Psycho-Pass, telling of new inspector Akane Tsunemori continuing to fight crime after losing her companion. This season introduces a new enforcer and an opposing enemy, centering on collective psychology and systemic criticism. The work continues the cyberpunk worldview and philosophical reflection; Akane's persistence between system and justice, the new enemy's schemes, and the analysis of collective crime run throughout. The anime's oppressive atmosphere and profound thought, with sharper criticism of the psycho-pass system, make it an exemplary sequel of sci-fi crime anime.

title: 记录的地平线 第二季
content: "Log Horizon" Season 2 continues the first season; Shiroe and the Log Horizon guild continue exploring in the Elder Tale world. This season centers on production, battles, and guild warfare; Shiroe maneuvers among various factions with strategy. The work features strategy, management, and MMO adventure; Shiroe's cool-headed mind games, guild management, and large-scale battles are highlights. The anime's faithful depiction of the MMO world and vivid ensemble portrayal make it a work emphasizing strategy and intelligence in MMO anime.

title: 四月是你的谎言
content: "Your Lie in April" adapts the same-name manga. After losing his ability to play the piano, pianist Kousei Arima meets the free-spirited violinist Kaori Miyazono, and the two redeem each other through music. The work is known for music, youth, and tearjerking narration; Kaori's secret and Kousei's rebirth moved countless viewers. Kousei rediscovers the joy of piano through duets with Kaori; the contrast between Kaori's liveliness and hidden sorrow is strong. The anime's performance scenes are moving and the soundtrack beautiful, and the ending's farewell brings tears—universally recognized as a tearjerking masterpiece.

title: 临时女友
content: "Girl Friend Beta" adapts the same-name game, telling the daily life of girls at Seiou Academy. The work presents the life fragments of many female characters in episodic format, centered on friendship, club activities, and youth. The anime features a fresh style and cute characters; the many appearing girls each have distinct personalities, and everything from daily trivia to school events is warm. The work has a slow pace and healing atmosphere, showing the girls' ordinary yet shining school life—suitable for viewers who like light daily life.

title: 七人魔法使
content: "Trinity Seven" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Arata Kasuga, after meeting a magic user girl, is drawn into the Demon Lord revival conspiracy and enters a magic academy as a chosen one candidate. The work features magic battles, harem elements, and passionate narration; Arata's growth and battles at the academy are highlights. The anime combines magic academy settings with harem interactions; Arata's awakening and the Demon Lord cult's conspiracy intertwine, with gorgeous battles and ample fan-service—a light, enjoyable fantasy battle series.

title: 日常系的异能战斗
content: "Inou-Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de" adapts the same-name light novel. Members of the literary club suddenly awaken superpowers, but without actual crises, they can only use them in daily life. The work features gags, contrast, and deconstruction of the superpower theme; it unfolds comedic daily life under the pretense of ability battles. The protagonists' superpowers are powerful yet useless, and various absurd daily conflicts are full of laughs; the anime's exaggerated performances and dense gags completely turn the serious superpower theme comedic—a uniquely creative comedy work.

title: 怪盗Joker
content: "Mysterious Joker" adapts the same-name manga, telling of boy phantom thief Joker stealing treasures around the world, battling rivals and police. The work features gorgeous magic, exaggerated performances, and episodic adventures; the adventures of Joker and his partner Hachi are fun. Joker's theft plans are always unexpected and imaginative; the anime's vivid performances and brisk pacing show Joker's wit and charm through adventures—a boy's adventure work suitable for family viewing.

title: 大图书馆的牧羊人
content: "Daitoshokan no Hitsujikai" adapts the same-name game. Boy Kyou Kakei meets Tsumugi Shirasaki and joins the library club, helping students in trouble. The work features school romance, a library, and youthful daily life, centered on the girls' dreams and the Shepherd legend. The library club members grow through helping others; the interactions between Kyou and Tsumugi are warm, and the anime's tranquil healing atmosphere explores dreams and choices against the library backdrop—a healing school work.

title: 爱·天地无用！
content: "Ai Tenchi Muyo!" is a short installment of the Tenchi Muyo series, continuing the daily life of Tenchi and the people around him. The work features Q-version characters, light comedy, and classic harem settings, parodying and reviewing the original. The Q-version interactions of Tenchi and the many characters are full of charm and laughs; the anime presents light daily life in extremely short episodes—a fan-oriented light work of the Tenchi Muyo series, suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: 关于完全听不懂老公在说什么的事
content: "Danna ga Nani wo Itteiru ka Wakaranai Ken" adapts a yonkoma manga, telling the daily life of an otaku husband and an ordinary wife. The wife cannot understand the husband's otaku speech; the two understand each other amid laughter. The work features short-form gags, a warm atmosphere, and otaku culture references. The anime comments from the wife's perspective on the husband's otaku behavior, from anime, games, to doujinshi, full of ACG gags and laughs; beyond the comedy, it shows the understanding and warmth between the couple—a light, healing daily work.

title: BUDDY COMPLEX 完结篇 -回到那片天空的未来-
content: "Buddy Complex: Into the Skies of the Future" is the finale of Buddy Complex, telling the final story of Aoba Watase and Hina Yumihara. Aoba makes a choice amid the truth of time jumps, and the bond of the two across time reaches its conclusion. The work is known for robot battles and a moving ending; the fates of Aoba and Hina intertwine in time paradoxes. The anime's ending is full of warmth and shock, drawing a satisfying conclusion for the time-crossing pair—a moving finale among robot anime.

title: 凭物语
content: "Tsukimonogatari" is part of the Monogatari series, telling of Koyomi Araragi facing a new oddity crisis after losing the protection of Yozuru Kagenui. This work focuses on Yotsugi's past; Araragi proceeds without being able to rely on vampire power. The work continues the series' unique dialogue and visual style; Yotsugi's existence and origin unfold in detailed narration, and Araragi's dealings with oddities carry the Monogatari series' signature. The anime's stylized direction and brilliant dialogue are as excellent as ever—a wonderful chapter of the Monogatari series.

title: 侦探歌剧 少女福尔摩斯 TD
content: "Tantei Opera Milky Holmes TD" is a Milky Holmes series anime telling of detective girls fighting the Phantom Thief Empire. The four girls show comedy and reasoning in their daily life and adventures at Milky Holmes Academy; the work features cute characters, parody, and a light atmosphere. The girls' reasoning always causes various blunders, and the Phantom Thief Empire's appearances bring endless laughs; the anime has brisk pacing and cute characters—a light comedic detective comedy.

title: 绝对双刃
content: "Absolute Duo" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Tooru Kokonoe enters Goryoukan Academy, which uses superpower tools, fighting with Absolute Duo abilities. The work features academy battles, harem elements, and passionate duels; Tooru gradually uncovers the world's truth through battle. The interactions between Tooru and girls like Julie and Eru are full of fan-service and ambiguity, and the ranking battles within the academy and duels against strong enemies are passionate; the anime's refined character designs and fluid battle scenes make it a standard light-novel academy battle series.

title: 大家集合！Falcom学园 2期
content: "Minna Atsumare! Falcom Gakuen" Season 2 continues the first season; the parody daily life of Falcom game characters at the academy continues. Characters from Trails, Ys, and other works gather, creating laughs through contrast and gags; the work is full of homage and commentary on Falcom works. The Q-version interactions of characters like Rean and Estelle are full of charm; the anime presents dense comedic bits in extremely short episodes—a light work Falcom fans shouldn't miss.

title: Doamaiger D
content: "Doamaiger D" is a short anime telling of the battles of the giant robot Doamaiger D. A mysterious giant doll and its operators clash in Tokyo; the work features hyper-expanded plots, psychedelic direction, and absurd comedy. The anime's nonsensical plot and unique directing style mix a large amount of parody into a serious robot setting, with blazing pace and wild imagination—an experimental comedic work full of psychedelic style.

title: 百合熊风暴
content: "Yuri Kuma Arashi" is an original anime directed by Kunihiko Ikuhara. In a world of opposition between humans and bears, girl Kureha and the bear girl Ginko develop a friendship transcending species. The work is known for Ikuhara-style symbolism, abstract direction, and fairy-tale atmosphere, exploring love, loneliness, and understanding. The rift between humans and bears and the bond between Kureha and Ginko unfold in Ikuhara's unique narration; the anime's vivid colors and highly impactful direction, with much room for interpretation in the ending, make it a uniquely styled artistic work.

title: 元气少女缘结神◎
content: "Kamisama Kiss" Season 2, titled "Kamisama Hajimemashita." After becoming a land god, high school girl Nanami Momozono lives with the familiar Tomoe; this season centers on the familiar's past and Nanami's growth. The work features romance, Japanese-style mythology, and warm daily life; the arc of Tomoe's past is moving, and Nanami's wavering between familiar and girl is full of sweetness and bitterness. The anime's beautiful Japanese-style atmosphere and the sugar-heavy interactions between Tomoe and Nanami make it a classic romance work.

title: 美男高校地球防卫部LOVE！
content: "Binan Koukou Chikyuu Boueibu LOVE!" is an original gag anime. Male students of a handsome boys' high school are chosen by aliens to transform into Earth Defense Club members and fight evil forces. The work features handsome boys, transformation, comedy, and parody, packaging a boy transformation theme with shoujo anime art style. The exaggerated gorgeous transformation scenes of the boys strongly contrast with the serious alien premise; the anime's direction is full of parody spirit with dense jokes—a highly creative comedic work.

title: 军人少女
content: This adapts a manga telling the daily life of military girls. The work combines military themes with comedic daily life; the girls engage in various absurd interactions around military knowledge, compact and full of gags. From gun knowledge to military tactics, the girls show the daily life of military enthusiasts in a funny way; the anime has brisk pacing and dense jokes—a light, stress-relieving military-themed short anime.

title: 舰队Collection
content: "Kantai Collection" adapts the same-name game, telling of ship girls fighting the Abyssal Fleet. Girls like Fubuki live and fight at the naval base; the work features anthropomorphized ships, battles, and healing daily life; the ship girls' designs and bonds are highlights. Fubuki's growth from a novice destroyer into a reliable warrior, the naval base girls' warm daily life, and battles against the Abyssal Fleet intertwine; the anime brings the anthropomorphized ship setting to the fullest—a representative ship girl work.

title: 新妹魔王的契约者
content: "Shinmai Maou no Testament" adapts the same-name light novel. After his father suddenly remarries, boy Toujou Basara gains two demon princess stepsisters and is forced into a master-servant contract with them. Taking care of these willful stepsisters drags him into demon clan conflicts, and his inner demon blood gradually awakens. The work combines fan-service, passionate battle, and harem elements; the daily interactions between Basara and Mio and Maria are full of gags and ambiguity, and the battle scenes are fiery—a typical light-novel school battle harem anime.

title: 血型君2
content: "Ketsuekigata-kun 2" is the second season of the blood-type series, unfolding comedic daily life with anthropomorphized A, B, O, and AB blood-type characters. The work generates laughs through the personality differences of the blood-type boys, exaggerating each blood type's traits so viewers can learn blood-type knowledge with a knowing smile. The animation is simple and cute, short and punchy; each episode revolves around a daily topic with rapid-fire gags and brisk pacing—a stress-relieving short anime.

title: PUNKISS！2次元
content: "PUNKISS! 2-jigen" is a short gag anime telling the hilarious daily life of protagonists discussing 2-D topics. The work focuses on otaku culture such as voice actors, anime, and games, with the characters earnestly discussing various otaku topics full of memes and snark. The animation is fast-paced with dense jokes, vividly depicting otaku daily life—a light comedy short for otaku.

title: 东京喰种√A
content: "Tokyo Ghoul Root A" is the second season of Tokyo Ghoul, telling the story of Kaneki Ken after joining Aogiri. Kaneki struggles between ghoul and human, gradually turning darker, while his relationships with Touka, Shuu, and others change. The work continues the previous season's oppressive atmosphere with crueler battles; Kaneki's transformation and the conflicts among ghoul organizations intertwine, and the tragic ending leaves viewers sighing over Kaneki's fate.

title: 路人女主的养成方法
content: "Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend" adapts the same-name light novel. Otaku boy Tomoya Aki decides to make a bishoujo game, and after meeting the girl Megumi Kato by chance he makes her the heroine, struggling alongside the senpai Utaha Kasumigaoka and childhood friend Eriri Spencer Sawamura to create the game. The work is themed on otaku culture, romantic comedy, and game production; the interactions between Tomoya and the charming heroines are full of gags and heartbeats, with vivid ensemble portrayal during production—a representative light-novel romantic comedy.

title: 幸腹涂鸦
content: "Koufuku Graffiti" adapts the same-name manga. After her grandmother passes away, high school girl Ryou Machiko lives alone and is emotionally scarred by her grandmother's cooking, but meeting the girl Kiriya reignites her love of food. The work is themed on food and the girls' daily life; each episode revolves around delicious dishes, and the mealtime moments of Ryou, Kiriya, Shiina, and friends are warm and healing. The anime depicts food exquisitely and appetizingly with a warm, bright atmosphere—a healing work that whets the appetite.

title: 铳皇无尽的法夫纳
content: "Juou Mujin no Fafnir" adapts the same-name light novel. In a world threatened by dragons, girls awaken as D with dragon power and train at an academy. Boy Yuu Mononobe enters the academy as the only male D, fighting the dragon threat with the girls. The work features academy battles, dragon power, and harem elements; Yuu shows his strength in battle after battle, and his interactions with the heroines are full of fan-service and ambiguity—a standard light-novel battle harem anime.

title: 苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS
content: "Fafner EXODUS" is a sequel in the Fafner series, telling of humanity piloting Fafner mechs to fight the otherworldly Festum.
