The boys and girls fight and sacrifice on the brutal battlefield to protect their comrades and homeland. The work is known for tragic war, profound exploration of life and death, and character bonds; the second-generation pilots' growth is moving, the mech battle scenes are refined, and the atmosphere is heavy yet touching—a classic of hardcore sci-fi anime.

title: 偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩
content: "The IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls" is an idol series anime telling the story of girls becoming idols in the Cinderella Project launched by 346 Production. Heroine Uzuki Shimamura and girls like Rin Shibuya and Mio Honda keep growing on the idol path; the work features ensemble portrayal, music, and dream-chasing stories. The Cinderella Girls each have distinct personalities, and their journey from auditions to the stage is full of sweat and emotion. The anime's song-and-dance scenes are gorgeous and characters delicately portrayed—an excellent idol anime.

title: JOJO的奇妙冒险 星尘斗士 埃及篇
content: "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders - Egypt Arc" is the latter half of the series' third part, as Jotaro and his group clash fiercely with DIO's subordinates on their way to Egypt. This season's Stand battles are even more brilliant; from the fateful final duel with DIO to the various bizarre Stand abilities, it is full of mind games and passion. The sacrifices and courage of Jotaro, Kakyoin, Polnareff, and others are moving, and the final showdown with DIO is a classic chapter etched into history.

title: 死亡游行
content: "Death Parade" is an original anime telling of the mysterious bar Quindecim, where the dead are asked to play games that reveal their true natures in life. Bartender Decim and the mysterious girl Chiyuki observe and judge these souls; the work is themed on humanity, life and death, and good and evil, each episode revealing a dead person's life and choices through games. The anime's atmosphere is heavy and profound, and its exploration of life and death is thought-provoking—a work of great intellectual depth.

title: 暗杀教室
content: "Assassination Classroom" adapts the same-name manga. The mysterious creature called Koro-sensei becomes the homeroom teacher of Class 3-E and threatens to destroy Earth in a year; the students must assassinate him within that time. The work is themed on school, comedy, and passion; Class 3-E's students grow through assassination training, and the bond between Koro-sensei and his students is moving. The anime skillfully combines hilarity and warmth, Koro-sensei is an unforgettable character—a work full of educational meaning and emotion.

title: 无头骑士异闻录×2 承
content: "Durarara!!x2 Shou" is a sequel in the Durarara!! series, telling a new chapter of Ikebukuro's urban legends. This season adds new characters atop the original cast, with events around the head, demonic sword, and all kinds of oddballs constantly unfolding, and the ensemble narration is as brilliant as ever. The anime uses multi-line parallel narration to weave Ikebukuro's chaotic daily life with conspiracies, with tight pacing and constant reversals—a classic of urban ensemble drama.

title: ALDNOAH.ZERO 第二季
content: "ALDNOAH.ZERO" Season 2 continues the first season, telling the fates of Inaho and Slaine in the war between Mars and Earth. This season further develops Inaho's relationship with Princess Asseylum and Slaine's ambition, with the truth of the war gradually revealed. The work is known for grand war scenes, mind games, and tragic overtones; the ending's reversal is shocking, and Inaho's calmness and Slaine's obsession run throughout—an impactful original robot work.

title: DOG DAYS''
content: "DOG DAYS''" is a DOG DAYS series anime telling of boy Shinku summoned to the otherworldly nation Biscotti as a hero participating in sports competitions between nations. The work features fantasy, competition, and a light atmosphere; Shinku clashes with warriors of various nations in matches, and his interactions with the princesses are warm. The battles are presented as sports with no death or bloodshed, bright and cheerful—a light work suitable for all ages.

title: 旋转少女
content: "The Rolling Girls" is an original anime telling the road trip of girls to protect world peace in a fictional Kanto. Protagonist Nozomi Moritomo and her partners set out on a journey; the work features road-movie, ensemble, and nonsensical comedy. The girls encounter all kinds of odd people and events on the way, with a unique art style and bold direction. The anime switches between comedy and seriousness, full of period flavor and imagination—a distinctly styled original work.

title: 黑子的篮球 第三季
content: "Kuroko's Basketball" Season 3 is the series' final season, as Seirin High's basketball team faces the strongest Rakuzan in the national tournament. This season Ryouta... Akashi's imperial power is fully displayed, and the final showdown between Kuroko and Kagami is gripping. The work is known for passionate matches and character growth; all of the Generation of Miracles assemble, every match full of tactics and passion, and Kuroko and Kagami's eruption in the final duel makes viewers' blood boil—a satisfying conclusion to the series.

title: 夜之小双侠
content: "Yoru no Yatterman" is a follow-up in the Yatterman series, centering on the descendants of the villains Yatterman. To stop the plutocratic clan that steals the world's treasures for fun, the boys who inherit the Yatterman name take action. The work is themed on mech battles, comedy, and revenge, with gorgeous art and exaggerated performances; paying homage to the classics while adding a new story, full of tension and reversals—a unique mech anime.

title: 纯洁的玛利亚
content: "Maria the Virgin Witch" adapts the same-name manga, telling of Maria, a witch with great magic in medieval France who protects her village's peace in her own way. Maria uses magic to stop war, making her a target of the church and angels. The work is themed on witches, war, and faith; Maria's choices between good and evil are full of deliberation, the art is classical and beautiful, and the depiction of medieval history is detailed—a work combining fantasy and thought.

title: 圣剑使的禁咒咏唱
content: "Seiken Tsukai no World Break" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Moroha Haimura, bearing memories of a past life, enters an academy after reincarnation and becomes a holy sword user with a double past life. The work features academy battles, forbidden spells, and harem elements; Moroha gradually reveals his strength in battles against magic-department students, and his interactions with the heroines are full of fan-service. The anime's battle scenes are gorgeous and settings novel—a typical light-novel school battle harem anime.

title: 战国无双
content: "Samurai Warriors" adapts the same-name game, telling the battles of Sengoku generals on the road to unification. Generals like Yukimura Sanada and Mitsuhide Akechi each hold beliefs and pour their passion into the battlefield. The work features gorgeous action scenes and a general ensemble; the Musou-style battle performances are exhilarating, and the bonds and fates of the generals intertwine. The anime plays out the generals' hero tales within a historical framework—a passionate work among game adaptations.

title: 美少女战士Crystal 第二季
content: "Sailor Moon Crystal" Season 2 continues the first season, as Usagi Tsukino and her companions fight new enemies. In this season's Black Moon arc, enemies from the future invade, and the fates of the Sailor Soldiers and Chibiusa intertwine. The work faithfully follows the original manga with gorgeous transformation and battle scenes; Usagi keeps growing in the battle to protect love and justice—a faithful reproduction of the classic magical girl series.

title: 伊斯卡
content: "Isuca" is a short anime telling the adventures of boy Isuca in a wondrous world. The work features fantasy settings and a unique art style; Isuca encounters all kinds of strange events on his travels, and the story is short yet imaginative. The anime has a light, mysterious atmosphere and highly recognizable art—a short work full of artistic flavor.

title: Go! Princess 光之美少女
content: "Go! Princess PreCure" is a Pretty Cure series anime telling of three girls transforming into Pretty Cures to fight enemies who try to steal people's dreams. The work is themed on princesses, dreams, and magic; girls like Haruno Haruka protect everyone's dreams in battle, with gorgeous costume and battle scenes. The anime balances passionate battle with warm daily life, conveying the power of dreams and friendship—an excellent girls' magical girl anime.

title: 动画心疗系
content: "Anime de Wakaru Shinryounaika" is a short anime themed on psychological treatment, popularizing mental health knowledge in a funny way. The protagonist and nurses explain various psychological symptoms with exaggerated performances; the work features parody, education, and absurdity, conveying mental health common sense amid laughter. The anime is short with dense jokes, presenting serious psychological topics in a light way—both entertaining and educational.

title: 关于完全听不懂老公在说什么的事 第二季
content: "Danna ga Nani wo Itteiru ka Wakaranai Ken" Season 2 continues the first season, telling the daily life of an otaku husband and an ordinary wife. The wife still cannot understand her husband's otaku speech; the two understand each other amid laughter, and this season adds new life chapters like pregnancy. The work features short-form gags, a warm atmosphere, and otaku culture references, showing the understanding and warmth between the couple amid comedy—a light, healing daily work.

title: 我的青春恋爱物语果然有问题 续
content: "My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO!" is the series' second season. Hachiman Hikigaya's relationships with Yukino Yukinoshita, Yui Yuigahama, and others undergo profound changes through the Service Club's activities. This season revolves around the cultural festival, requests, and the complex feelings among the three; Hachiman's self-sacrificing way of solving problems sparks more thought. The work is known for delicate psychological portrayal and profound exploration of youth; the characters' inner monologues and entanglements are memorable.

title: 灵感少女！
content: "Re-Kan!" adapts the same-name manga. High school girl Hibiki Amami can see ghosts, which makes her treated as a chuunibyou. She gradually grows through her daily life with ghosts and friends; the work features ghosts, comedy, and daily life, and the interactions between Hibiki and kind ghosts are warm and funny. The anime has cute art and a light atmosphere, showing the girl's growth amid light comedy—a healing daily work.

title: 魔法少女奈叶ViVid
content: "Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha ViVid" is a Nanoha series anime telling the growth of Nanoha's daughter Vivio. Vivio trains hard to compete in a martial arts tournament, growing through competition with friends. The work is themed on magical girl battles, competition, and family love; the bond between Vivio and her mother Nanoha and the duels with companions are full of passion and warmth, with gorgeous battle scenes—an important chapter of the magical girl series.

title: 在地下城寻求邂逅是否搞错了什么
content: "Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Bell Cranel keeps challenging the dungeon to grow stronger in the adventurer's guild of the labyrinth city Orario. He encounters powerful monsters and a mysterious girl deep in the dungeon, gradually uncovering its secrets. The work features dungeon exploration, adventure, and passionate battle; Bell's growth and adventures are full of charm, and the battle scenes are exciting—a popular fantasy adventure work.

title: 长门有希酱的消失
content: "The Disappearance of Nagato Yuki-chan" is a spin-off of the Haruhi Suzumiya series, telling the romance daily life of ordinary high school girl Yuki Nagato and Kyon in a parallel world. In this world without Haruhi, Yuki is no longer an alien but a shy ordinary girl. The work features romance, daily life, and youth; Yuki's growth and interactions with Kyon are warm, the art is fresh—a healing school romance work.

title: 吸血鬼福尔摩斯
content: "Vampire Holmes" is a short anime telling the hilarious daily life of Holmes, who claims to be a vampire, and his companions in London. Holmes' reasoning is always full of gags, and his interactions with Watson and others are nonstop laughs. The work features parody, mystery, and comedy, completely absurdifying the classic detective setting; the anime is short with brisk pacing—a stress-relieving comedy short.

title: 食戟之灵
content: "Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma" adapts the same-name manga, telling of boy Souma Yukihira challenging masters through cooking duels at the elite culinary school Tootsuki Academy. Souma keeps growing through brutal cooking competitions, facing off against distinctive opponents in shokugeki; the work features food, passion, and competition. The anime's depictions of food are mouth-watering, the match scenes tense and exciting, and Souma's creative cooking and never-give-up spirit are infectious—a classic of food anime.

title: 宝石宠物 Magical Change
content: "Jewelpet Magical Change" is a Jewelpet series anime telling the magical adventures of a girl and the Jewelpet creatures. The protagonists carry out various activities in the magic world with the Jewelpets, collecting jewels and helping others. The work features cute characters, magical transformation, and girls' daily life, conveying themes of friendship and dreams; the visuals are bright and the atmosphere warm—a healing magical daily anime for girl viewers.

title: 美妙天堂 第二期
content: "PriPara" Season 2 continues the first season, as girls continue idol activities in the idol theme park PriPara. Manaka Laala and her partners face more challenges on new stages and meet new idol friends. The work features gorgeous stage performances, cute characters, and a light plot; the song-and-dance scenes are infectious, and Laala's growth and friendship are heartwarming—a classic girls' idol series.

title: 电波教师
content: "Denpa Kyoushi" adapts the same-name manga. A science-loving young man who claims he can learn nothing but 2-D takes over an educational problem class as a substitute big brother. He uses his unique teaching methods to help students find their goals; the work features education, comedy, and inspiration, and Junichirou's unconventional teaching is fun and touching. The anime conveys educational philosophy amid light comedy—a work combining entertainment and depth.

title: 境界的轮回
content: "Kyokai no Rinne" adapts Rumiko Takahashi's same-name manga. Girl Sakura Mamiya can see ghosts and meets the half-death god boy Rinne Rokudou; the two work together to help ghosts pass on. The work features the supernatural, comedy, and daily life; Sakura and Rinne interact while solving paranormal cases, and Takahashi's signature comedic style runs throughout with light episodic stories—a warm supernatural daily work.

title: 终结的炽天使
content: "Seraph of the End" adapts the same-name manga. In a world destroyed by a virus, vampires rule the surviving humans. Boy Yuuichirou Hyakuya joins a human resistance organization to avenge the vampires, fighting alongside his best friend Mikaela... and companions like Shinoa. The work is themed on vampires, battle, and revenge; Yuu's anger and growth run throughout, the battle scenes are gorgeous, and the atmosphere is dark yet passionate—a popular work in the vampire genre.

title: 恶魔高校 D×D BorN
content: "High School DxD BorN" is a series anime telling the growth of demon high school student Issei Hyoudou. After becoming a demon, Issei keeps growing stronger; this season he is drawn into battles with fallen angels and Sacred Gear users, with plenty of fan-service interactions with the heroines. The work features battle, harem, and comedy; Issei's hot-blooded yet perverted style is uniquely charming, and the battle scenes are gorgeous—a light and enjoyable light-novel harem battle anime.

title: 枪神斯托拉塔斯
content: "Gunslinger Stratos" adapts the same-name game, telling the battles of boys in a near-future world split into two major powers. The protagonists carry out missions in an anti-gravity world, engaging in gunfights with hostile forces. The work features sci-fi, gunfights, and passion; the battle scenes are fluid, the characters' growth and bonds run throughout, and the settings are novel—a standard sci-fi battle anime.

title: Fate/stay night [Unlimited Blade Works] 第二季
content: "Fate/stay night [Unlimited Blade Works]" Season 2 is the second season; Shirou Emiya's duel with Archer and the truth of the Holy Grail War fully unfold this season. Shirou's insistence on idealism sharply contrasts with Archer's disillusionment, and his bonds with Saber and Rin are elevated in the final battle. The work is known for gorgeous battles, a grand worldview, and profound themes; ufotable's production quality is industry-leading—the peak of the Fate series.

title: 可塑性记忆
content: "Plastic Memories" is an original anime telling of a future where humanoid robots with memories are common; boy Tsukasa Mizugaki joins a company responsible for retrieving end-of-life robots. He gradually deepens his feelings with his partner robot Isla during retrieval missions, yet must face her destined memory loss. The work is themed on the emotions between robots and humans and farewell; tearjerking plot and warm daily life intertwine, and the ending is moving—a deeply touching sci-fi work.

title: 歌之王子殿下 真爱REVOLUTIONS
content: "Uta no Prince-sama: Maji Love Revolutions" is a series anime telling the romance of heroine Haruka Nanami, who enters an arts school, with the idols. This season Haruka and the six idols continue to grow on the path of music and entertainment; the work features music, romance, and idols, with gorgeous stage performances and moving songs throughout. The interactions between Haruka and the idols are sugary—a representative female-oriented idol anime.

title: 血界战线
content: "Blood Blockade Battlefront" adapts the same-name manga. After New York is connected to the otherworld, boy Leonardo enters the secret organization Libra in a city where otherworldly beings and humans coexist. The work features urban fantasy, passionate battle, and ensemble; Leo plays a role in battle with his powerful eyesight, and his interactions with Libra members are full of gags and emotion. The anime's battle scenes are gorgeous and pacing tight—a charming fantasy work.

title: 亚尔斯兰战记
content: "The Heroic Legend of Arslan" adapts Yoshiki Tanaka's novel. Prince Arslan of the Pars kingdom, after his kingdom falls to an enemy nation, embarks on the road to restore it. He gathers wise generals and companions in his flight, step by step toward the path of kingship. The work is themed on history, war, and hero growth; Arslan's benevolence and wisdom, and his bonds with generals like Daryun, run throughout. The anime's war scenes are grand—a work full of epic flavor.

title: 网球优等生 第二季
content: "Baby Steps" Season 2 continues the first season, as Eiichirou Maruo keeps growing in tennis competition. Through data analysis and hard training, Maruo climbs to higher stages, with fiercer duels against strong opponents. The work is known for realistic tennis techniques, scientific training, and the protagonist's growth; the match depictions are detailed and professional, and Maruo's calmness and persistence are admirable—a solid sports work.

title: SHOW BY ROCK!!
content: "SHOW BY ROCK!!" is a music anime telling the adventures of band girls. The bands led by guitarist Cyan fight evil forces in the music world, saving the world with the power of rock. The work features music, cute characters, and comedy; the bands' performances are infectious, the characters' daily interactions are full of gags, and the pacing is brisk—a light and enjoyable music anime.

title: 雨色可可
content: "Amaama... Rainy Cocoa" is a short anime telling the daily life of the cafe Rainy Color. The cafe staff and customers interact around coffee; the work features healing, daily life, and coffee, each episode revolving around a small story at the cafe. The anime has fresh art and a tranquil atmosphere, with the aroma of coffee and people's daily lives intertwined—a healing short work suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: HELLO!! 黄金拼图
content: "HELLO!! Kin-iro Mosaic" is the second season of the Kin-iro Mosaic series, telling the school daily life of the girls. Alice comes to Japan from England and spends happy times at school with friends Youko, Aya, and others; the work features moe daily life, friendship, and healing. The girls' interactions are full of charm and gags, with bright cute art and a relaxed warm atmosphere—a representative moe daily anime.

title: 钻石王牌 第二季
content: "Ace of Diamond" Season 2 continues the first season, as Seidou High's baseball team keeps fighting for Koshien. Eijun Sawamura, Kazuya Miyuki, and teammates keep growing in matches; this season's opponents are stronger and matches more intense. The work is known for realistic baseball tactics, detailed match depiction, and character growth; Sawamura's pitching progress and the team's unity make viewers' blood boil—a classic baseball anime.

title: 怪盗Joker2
content: "Mysterious Joker" Season 2 continues the series, as boy phantom thief Joker keeps stealing treasures around the world, outwitting rivals and police. This season adds new rivals and partners, with even more spectacular magic theft plans. The work features gorgeous magic, exaggerated performances, and episodic adventures; the adventures of Joker and Hachi are fun, and the anime's vivid colorful direction and brisk pacing make it a work suitable for young viewers.

title: 闪乱神乐
content: "Senran Kagura" adapts the same-name game, telling the battles and daily life of ninja girls at the academy. The ninja girls of Hanzo Academy clash with evil ninja forces; the work features ninja, battle, and fan-service elements. The girls' ninjutsu duels are gorgeous and thrilling, and their daily interactions are full of fan-service; the anime combines passionate battle with light daily life, with vivid charming characters—a work with both action and moe.

title: 黏黏糊糊!!角质君 第2期
content: This is the second season of the short anime about the anthropomorphized keratin character. Continuing the first season, it unfolds absurd daily life from the keratin character's perspective. The keratin character's life is still full of wild ideas and laughs; the work features exaggerated performances and absurd settings, and the anime is short with blazing pace, showing the keratin's bizarre daily life amid light comedy—a wild-brain short anime.

title: 网球并不可笑嘛 4期
content: "Teekyuu" Season 4 continues the series, as the tennis club girls' nonsensical daily life goes on. The work features rapid-fire gags, exaggerated performances, and wild-brain segments, turning tennis matches into various hilarious scenes; each episode is extremely short yet packed with jokes—a light short anime that makes viewers laugh out loud, perfect for stress relief in spare time.

title: 我是高宫茄乃
content: This is a spin-off short of Non Non Biyori, unfolding leisurely episodes of the character's rural life from a specific point of view. The art style matches the main series, with a light healing atmosphere. The anime is short, centered on the character's daily life and fun moments—a must-see side story for Non Non Biyori fans.

title: 御神乐学园组曲
content: "Mikagura Gakuen Kumikyoku" adapts the same-name light novel. Boy Ichigaya Manabi enters Mikagura Academy, which gathers all kinds of talents, and is drawn into school activities held by the clubs' alliance. The work features school battles, comedy, and ensemble; the academy's bizarre settings and interactions of various characters are fun, and the anime unfolds school competitions amid light comedy—a brisk school comedy.

title: 吹响吧！上低音号
content: "Sound! Euphonium" adapts the same-name novel, telling the youth story of the girls of Kitauji High's concert band. Heroine Kumiko Oumae strives with her clubmates toward a goal, competing and chasing dreams. The work is themed on music, youth, and growth; Kumiko's growth and the clubmates' bonds are delicate and moving, the visuals and music are excellent, and the performance scenes are infectious—a classic of Kyoto Animation.

title: 银魂°
content: "Gintama" (Season) continues the Gintama series, telling the hilarious daily life of Yorozuya Gin and his partners in Edo. This season includes popular chapters and a serious mainline; Gin switches between comedy and passion, and the stories with the Joui rebels and the Shogun are charming. The work features parody, snark, and passion, combining nonsensical comedy with touching plots; Gintama's unique style is addictive—a universally recognized comedic masterpiece.

title: 绝命制裁X
content: "Triage X" adapts the same-name manga, telling of the girls of the special unit Black Label carrying out sanction missions. The girls hide behind legal identities to fight villains the law cannot punish; the work features action, battle, and uniforms. The girls' battle scenes are gorgeous, and the tension of missions and the warmth of daily life intertwine; the pacing is brisk—a standard action work.

title: 俺物语!!
content: "My Love Story!!" adapts the same-name manga, telling the love story of Takeo Gouda, a burly man with a gentle heart. Takeo falls for the gentle girl Rinko Yamato, and his friendship with best friend Sunakawa Makoto is also moving. The work features romance, friendship, and gap moe; Takeo is pure and kind despite his scary looks, and his interactions with Rinko are sugary, with a warm healing atmosphere—a love story full of positive energy.

title: 放学后的昴星团
content: "Houkago no Pleiades" adapts from the animation project, telling the story of girls collecting fragments with aliens. The girls of the Pleiades drive vehicles on adventures to collect scattered star fragments; the work features magical girls, sci-fi, and daily life. The girls' adventures are fun, the art is fresh, and the character interactions are warm; the anime unfolds sci-fi adventures in a light atmosphere—a healing magical girl work.

title: 干支魂
content: "Etotama" adapts the multimedia project telling the battles of the girls representing the twelve zodiac animals. To compete for the status of zodiac god representative, the girls hold an elimination tournament; the story of the protagonist and her companions is passionate. The work features anthropomorphized zodiac, battle, and comedy; the characters each have distinct personalities, and the battle scenes are gorgeous with brisk pacing—a light passionate fantasy work.

title: Punch Line
content: "Punch Line" is an original anime telling of boy Yuuta Iridatsu, cursed so that seeing panties will destroy the world. Yuuta takes action to lift the curse; the work features wild ideas, comedy, and mystery, with absurd funny settings. The anime's plot is full of reversals and gags, hiding layers of riddles beneath the absurd surface, and the ending is surprising—a highly creative work.

title: 浦和小调
content: This is a short anime set in Urawa, Saitama, telling the girls' daily life. The work features local scenery and character interactions with a regional promotional flavor; the girls' daily fragments are light and warm. The anime is short with cute art, showing Urawa's charm in easy daily life—a healing work with local color.

title: 伪恋：
content: "Nisekoi:" is the second season of the Nisekoi anime, continuing the romantic comedy of Raku Ichijou, Chitoge Kirisaki, and others. This season centers on the interactions between Raku and many female characters, with the mystery of first love and the romance lines developing further. The work features cheerful romantic comedy and complex character relationships; misunderstandings and coincidences keep coming, dense with jokes and sugar—a classic romantic comedy anime.

title: 希德尼娅的骑士 第九惑星战役
content: "Knights of Sidonia: Battle for Planet Nine" is the second season of Knights of Sidonia; Nagate Tanikaze and Sidonia's warriors continue fighting the Gauna. This season's battles are fiercer, and Nagate's bonds with Shizuka Hoshijiro and others deepen further; the work is known for 3DCG, hardcore sci-fi settings, and grand cosmic war, with shocking battle scenes—a representative hard sci-fi anime.

title: 圣斗士星矢 黄金魂 -soul of gold-
content: "Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold" tells the battles of the Gold Saints in Northern Europe. Led by Aiolos, the resurrected Gold Saints fight to protect Goddess Athena. The work is themed on classic Saint Seiya battles, the charm of the Gold Cloths, and passion; the Gold Saints each display their skills with gorgeous battle scenes—a must-see for Saint Seiya fans.

title: 灰色的迷宫
content: "Grisaia no Meikyuu" is a sequel to Grisaia no Kajitsu, telling the past and present of Yuuji Kazami at the academy. This season reveals the past of Yuuji and the girls, unfolding around the truth of the labyrinth academy. The work features a dark atmosphere, psychological portrayal, and character bonds; Yuuji's growth and the girls' redemption intertwine, and the narration progresses layer by layer—the bridge chapter of the Grisaia series.

title: 山田君与7个魔女
content: "Yamada-kun and the Seven Witches" adapts the same-name manga. Problem boy Ryuu Yamada, after falling and kissing honor student Urara Shiraishi, accidentally swaps bodies, discovering that kissing can trigger supernatural powers. The work features superpowers, romantic comedy, and school; Yamada gets entangled with many girls while discovering witches, and the anime's settings are novel and fun, with Yamada's growth and love line full of gags—a light and enjoyable school romance work.

title: 英国一家，吃在日本
content: This is a short anime telling of a British family who moved to Japan enjoying Japanese food. The work features food, daily life, and cultural exchange; the British family's dining experiences in Japan are fun, and the anime combines Japanese cuisine with the British family's reactions, with cute art and a light atmosphere—a short work with both food and fun.

title: 灰色的乐园
content: "Grisaia no Rakuen" is the final chapter of the Grisaia series, as the story of Yuuji Kazami and the academy girls concludes. This season revolves around Yuuji's past and the girls' futures, with the truth of the labyrinth academy and each character's redemption intertwined. The work is known for its dark atmosphere, psychological portrayal, and warm ending; Yuuji and the girls face the past together and move toward the future, and the narrative is complete and moving—a satisfactory conclusion to the Grisaia series.

title: 我老婆是学生会长
content: "Okusama ga Seitokaichou!" (My Wife Is the Student Council President) is a short anime telling the romantic comedy between student council president Ui Wakana and vice president Hayato Izumi. After being elected president, Ui starts living with Hayato; the work features romance, comedy, and fan-service. Their interactions are full of gags and ambiguity, and the anime is short with brisk pacing—a stress-relieving romantic comedy short.

title: 黑街匪徒
content: "Gangsta." adapts the same-name manga, telling of the struggles between the vigilantes of the twilight town Ergastulum and various factions. Bounty hunters and gangs maneuver in the city's shadows; the work features gangs, action, and ensemble, with a hard-boiled art style and gloomy atmosphere. The characters' struggles in the gray zone are full of tension, and the plot is tight—a work full of adult flavor.

title: Chaos Dragon 赤龙战役
content: "Chaos Dragon: Sekiryuu Seneki" adapts a multimedia project, telling the adventures of boys in an otherworld dominated by a red dragon. Protagonist Ibuki sets out to protect the people he cares about, drawn into a war over the red dragon; the work features fantasy, adventure, and ensemble, with a vast worldview and intertwined fates of characters. The plot rises and falls—a work full of fantasy flavor.

title: 创圣的大天使LOGOS
content: "Aquarion Logos" is an Aquarion series anime telling of boys and girls piloting Aquarion machines to fight mysterious enemies. Protagonist Akira Kaibuki awakens his ability at the academy and fights with companions against enemies eroding reality; the work features mech battles, passion, and school. The combined battle of the Aquarion units is gorgeous, and the characters' growth and bonds run throughout; the battle scenes are shocking.

title: 乱步奇谭 拉普拉斯的游戏
content: "Rampo Kitan: Game of Laplace" adapts from Edogawa Ranpo's works, telling of genius high school student Kobayashi participating in solving bizarre cases. Kobayashi and Inspector Akechi are drawn into the Game of Laplace while pursuing a mysterious criminal; the work features mystery, suspense, and a dark atmosphere, modernizing Ranpo's detective world with a plot full of reversals and shocks—a uniquely styled mystery work.

title: 青春×机关枪
content: "Aoharu x Kikanjuu" adapts the same-name manga, telling of boys and girls participating in survival games. High school girl Hotaru Tachibana joins a survival game battle to save a friend, competing on the field with partners. The work features gunfights, passion, and youth; the tactical duels of survival games are tense and exciting, and the characters' growth and bonds in competition run throughout. The battle scenes are fluid—a work full of vitality.

title: 城下町的蒲公英
content: "Joukamachi no Dandelion" adapts the same-name manga. In a royal family with many children, the princesses' superpower competition begins to decide the next king. Protagonist Shio Sakurada gradually comes to understand the responsibility of royalty amid the competition among her many siblings. The work features royal daily life, superpowers, and comedy; there are many characters each with charm, and the anime unfolds the royal election amid light comedy—a warm and fun work.

title: 黑塔利亚 第6期
content: "Hetalia" Season 6 is a Hetalia series anime, as the anthropomorphized countries continue their comedic daily life. Countries of the world interact as cute characters, constantly joking about history, culture, and national relations; the work features parody, history, and comedy, with distinct characters. The anime is short with dense jokes—a representative of historical anthropomorphization.

title: 潮与虎
content: "Ushio to Tora" is the integrated version of the Ushio to Tora anime, telling the adventures of boy Ushio Aotsuki and the beast Tora. Ushio wields the Beast Spear and fights side by side with Tora against various yokai and the mastermind behind them; the work features passionate battle, friendship, and Japanese-style yokai. The growth of Ushio and Tora from confrontation to trust is moving, and the fight scenes are shocking—a classic of yokai battle anime.

title: 黑白小姐 第二季
content: "Miss Monochrome" Season 2 continues the first season, as virtual idol Miss Monochrome keeps chasing her idol dream. Monochrome's daily life is still full of absurdity and laughs; the work features exaggerated performances and rapid-fire gags, and the anime is short with blazing pace, with endless funny stories in Monochrome's dream-chasing—a stress-relieving comedy short.

title: 兔宝的悲惨日常 梦幻篇
content: This is a sequel to the Wooser series, telling the miserable yet funny daily life of the bullied rabbit Wooser. The work features black humor, parody, and daily life; Wooser's unlucky experiences are full of gags, and the anime has simple art and brisk pacing, showing Wooser's cuteness and misery amid light comedy—a unique comedy short.

title: 若叶女孩
content: "Wakaba*Girl" adapts the same-name manga, telling the daily life of high school girl Wakaba. Wakaba spends relaxing happy times with her friends at school; the work features daily life, healing, and friendship, with warm cute interactions between the girls and fresh art. The anime is short with a light atmosphere, showing the girls' ordinary school life—a daily work suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: GATE 奇幻自卫队
content: "GATE: Jieitai Kanochi nite, Kaku Tatakaeri" adapts the same-name novel, telling of the Self-Defense Forces crossing into another world. The JSDF contacts otherworldly civilizations through the opened gate; boy Youji Itami... the protagonist Itami carries out adventures and investigations in the otherworld. The work features military, fantasy, and adventure; the cultural collision between the JSDF and the otherworld is fun, and the anime combines military settings with fantasy elements—a work with a novel theme.

title: 教室☆危机
content: "Classroom Crisis" is an original anime telling of boys and girls at a high-tech academy on Mars orbit. Genius students like the protagonist get drawn into various incidents through class activities at the academy; the work features school, comedy, and sci-fi, and the characters' interactions are full of gags. The anime unfolds sci-fi settings amid light comedy with brisk pacing—a light and enjoyable school work.

title: 战姬绝唱SYMPHOGEAR GX
content: "Senki Zesshou Symphogear GX" is a Symphogear series anime telling of girls who fight using song. The Symphogear-wearing warriors use song as power to fight the mysterious Noise; this season new threats and characters appear. The work features music, battle, and passion; the performances combining singing and combat are infectious, and the warriors' bonds and sacrifices are moving—a representative of music battle anime.

title: 无头骑士异闻录×2 转
content: "Durarara!!x2 Ten" is a series anime continuing the ensemble narration of Ikebukuro's urban legends. This season revolves around new characters and events, as Ikebukuro's oddballs continue their chaotic daily life; the work features multi-line narration, urban suspense, and ensemble, with dizzying reversals and interweavings. The anime has tight pacing and many characters—a classic of urban ensemble drama.

title: 夏洛特
content: "Charlotte" is an original anime by Key x P.A.WORKS, telling of boy Yuu Otosaka with special abilities. After meeting student council girl Nao Tomori, Yuu joins Hoshinoumi Academy and helps other ability users; the work features superpowers, youth, and tragicomedy. Yuu's growth and the world's truth unfold layer by layer, and the anime switches between comedic daily life and tearjerking plot, with a shocking ending reversal.

title: 迷糊餐厅 第三季
content: "Working!!" Season 3 continues the series, telling the comedic daily life of the staff at the family restaurant Wagnaria. Souta Takanashi and the quirky staff's interactions at the restaurant are full of gags; the work features daily life, comedy, and ensemble, and the characters' snark and entanglements make viewers laugh. The anime has a relaxed happy atmosphere—a classic of comedic daily anime.

title: 没有黄段子存在的无聊世界
content: "Shimoneta to Iu Gainen ga Sonzai Shinai Taikutsu na Sekai" adapts the same-name light novel. In a future Japan with strict moral laws, boy Tanukichi Okuma joins a pure school organization to pursue a senpai, but is accidentally drawn into an underground organization that spreads obscene materials. The work features parody, snark, and fan-service, with absurd funny settings; the anime has exaggerated performances and dense jokes—a gag work full of mischief.

title: 科学小飞侠Crowds insight
content: "Gatchaman Crowds insight" is a series anime telling of girls using NOTES to protect the world. Hitomi... the protagonist Ichinose Hajime and her companions face new enemies; the work features sci-fi, ensemble, and social issues, exploring collective consciousness and individual value. The anime has a distinct style and unique direction, and the plot is full of deliberation—a work of great depth in the Gatchaman series.

title: 六花的勇者
content: "Rokka no Yuusha" adapts the same-name light novel. In the crisis of the Demon King's revival, six chosen heroes gather, but among them an enemy is mixed in. Protagonist Adlet fights to prove his innocence; the work features fantasy, mystery, and mind games, with suspicion among the heroes and the reveal of truth progressing layer by layer. The plot is tight and the atmosphere tense—a fantasy work full of reversals.

title: 龙珠超
content: "Dragon Ball Super" is a new Dragon Ball work telling of Goku and his friends' battles in new chapters like the Tournament of Power. This work introduces new characters such as the Gods of Destruction and the Omni-King; Goku keeps breaking through in battles in the realm of gods. The work features passionate battle, humor, and a grand worldview; the battle scenes are gorgeous, and Goku's growth and bonds with friends run throughout—a new chapter of the Dragon Ball series.

title: 和歌子酒
content: "Wakako-zake" is a short anime telling of working woman Wakako Murasaki enjoying food and sake after work. The work features food, healing, and solitude; Wakako's scenes of drinking alone are full of atmosphere, and the anime combines tempting food with the pleasure of tipsiness. The art is simple and the pace slow—a food healing work suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: 噬神者
content: "God Eater" adapts the same-name game, telling of the God Eaters who fight using God Arcs in a world devastated by Aragami. Boy Lenka Utsugi joins a God Eater unit and fights Aragami with his companions; the work features battle, sci-fi, and survival. The anime has a unique art style and gorgeous battle scenes; Lenka grows through battles, and the clashes with Aragami are tense—an excellent game adaptation.

title: 赤发白雪姬
content: "Akagami no Shirayuki-hime" adapts the same-name manga. Girl Shirayuki, blessed with natural red hair, leaves the palace to escape becoming a prince's concubine, and meets young King Zen in the neighboring country. The two grow closer in court life, unfolding a romantic tale; the work features romance, court, and adventure. Shirayuki's independence and strength pair beautifully with Zen's gentleness, and the anime's visuals are fresh and beautiful—a work full of girlish heart.

title: 出包王女Darkness 第二季
content: "To LOVE-Ru Darkness" Season 2 is a To LOVE-Ru series anime, continuing the harem daily life of Rito and many girls. This season revolves around the Dark sister and Momo's plan, with Rito's troubles escalating; the work features romantic comedy, fan-service, and parody, and the anime is rich in fan-service scenes with dense jokes—a representative harem anime.

title: 网球并不可笑嘛 5期
content: "Teekyuu" Season 5 continues the series, as the tennis club girls' nonsensical daily life goes on. The work features rapid-fire gags, exaggerated performances, and wild-brain segments, turning tennis into various hilarious scenes; each episode is extremely short yet packed with jokes—a light short anime that makes viewers laugh out loud, perfect for stress relief in spare time.

title: 其实我是
content: "Jitsu wa Watashi wa" (Actually, I Am...) adapts the same-name manga. The girl the protagonist is secretly in love with turns out to be a vampire. To keep her secret, the protagonist helps her hide her identity; the work features supernatural, romantic comedy, and comedy, revolving around many girls hiding their true identities. The anime's settings are absurd and funny with dense jokes, and the protagonist's interactions with the characters are full of fun—a light and enjoyable school comedy.

title: 悠哉日常大王 Repeat
content: "Non Non Biyori Repeat" is the second season of Non Non Biyori, continuing the leisurely daily life of the rural school girls. Renge Miyauchi and the Koshigaya sisters spend ordinary yet wonderful times through the changing seasons; the work features healing, daily life, and rural scenery. The slow pace, fresh art, and Renge's catchphrase bring knowing smiles—a representative healing daily anime.

title: 百万偶像
content: This is a short anime telling the struggle stories of girls aspiring to be idols. The work features idols, daily life, and comedy; the girls' interactions in their dream-chasing are fun, and the anime is short with brisk pacing, showing the idol industry's daily life in a light atmosphere—a stress-relieving idol short anime.

title: 怪兽酒场干杯！
content: This is a short anime telling the daily life of monsters at a tavern. At a monster-themed tavern, the interactions between various monster characters and human customers are fun; the work features comedy, daily life, and monsters, with a unique art style and light atmosphere, showing various nonsensical stories in the monster tavern setting—a unique comedy short.

title: OVERLORD
content: "OVERLORD" adapts the same-name light novel. When the popular game shuts down, protagonist Suzuki Satoru and his guild are transported to another world, becoming the strongest mage Ainz Ooal Gown. As an undead monarch, Ainz builds power in the otherworld; the work features otherworld, dark fantasy, and ensemble. Ainz's power and caution form a charming contrast, and the anime has a vast worldview and many characters—a classic of the isekai genre.

title: 那就是声优！
content: "Sore ga Seiyuu!" is a short anime telling the struggle stories of new voice actors. The work is themed on the real daily life of the voice acting industry; the protagonists grow through auditions, recordings, and work, with many real voice actor cameos and industry memes. The art is cute and the atmosphere light, showing the industry's hardships and charm while being warm—a healing industry work.

title: 魔物娘的同居日常
content: "Monster Musume no Iru Nichijou" adapts the same-name manga. In a modern world where humans and demi-humans coexist, boy Kimihito Kurusu lives with several monster girls arranged by the government. The work features monster girls, harem, and fan-service; Kimihito's cohabitation life with various monster girls is full of gags and ambiguity. The anime's settings are novel and fun with plenty of fan-service—a light and enjoyable non-human harem work.

title: 比基尼勇士
content: "Bikini Warriors" is a short anime telling the adventures of girl warriors wearing bikini armor. The girls set out to defeat the Demon King in a fantasy world; the work features battle, fan-service, and parody. The anime combines bishoujo with adventure, full of fan-service visuals with a light fast plot—a short work centered on visual service.

title: 洲崎西 THE ANIMATION
content: "Suzaki Nishi THE ANIMATION" is a short anime adapting from the radio program of the voice actor unit Suzaki Nishi. The anime is themed on the daily interactions of the two voice actors; the work features comedy, voice actors, and daily life, visualizing the radio's memes and their interactions. It is short with dense jokes—a must-see for fans of the voice actor unit.

title: 空战魔导士候补生的教官
content: "Kuusen Madoushi Kouhosei no Kyoukan" adapts the same-name light novel. In a world threatened by magic beetles, boy Kanata as an instructor of sky warrior mages teaches the cadets to fight. The work features aerial battles, school, and harem; Kanata's interactions with the girl cadets are full of fan-service, and the anime's battle scenes are gorgeous with novel settings—a standard light-novel school battle anime.

title: 纯情罗曼史3
content: "Junjo Romantica 3" is a Junjo Romantica series anime, telling the love stories of Misaki, Usami, and other BL couples. This season continues depicting the emotional development of several couples; the work features BL romance, warmth, and comedy, with sweet moving interactions. The anime balances romance and humor—a classic BL anime.

title: 干物妹！小埋
content: "Himouto! Umaru-chan" adapts the same-name manga. Umaru Doma, perfect honor student outside and a slacker little sister at home, has a hilarious cohabitation daily life with her brother Taihei. The work features daily life, comedy, and sibling love; Umaru's slothful home demeanor contrasts adorably with her perfect outside image. The anime has cute art and a light atmosphere—a healing comedic daily work.

title: 学园孤岛
content: "Gakkou Gurashi!" adapts the same-name manga. In a world after an infection outbreak, the girls of the School Living Club survive on campus; the work features post-apocalyptic survival, healing, and horror. The girls live a seemingly peaceful daily life in the abandoned school, but a cruel truth is hidden; the anime switches between warmth and despair with an impactful ending—a work of strong contrast.

title: 群居姐妹
content: "Danchigai" is a short anime telling the daily life of a protagonist living with several older sisters. The work features family comedy, fan-service, and comedy; the protagonist's interactions with the distinct older sisters are full of gags, and the anime is short with brisk pacing, showing family warmth amid light comedy—a stress-relieving short anime.

title: 监狱学园
content: "Prison School" adapts the same-name manga. At the private Hachimitsu Academy with strict rules, five boys are imprisoned for violating school rules, unfolding an absurd survival comedy. The work features comedy, parody, and fan-service; the boys outwit the student council in prison, and the anime has exaggerated performances and dense jokes—a school comedy full of mischief.

title: 维纳斯计划 CLIMAX
content: "Venus Project: Climax" is a Venus Project anime telling the struggle stories of girl idols. Themed on the Venus Project selection, the girls keep growing on the idol path; the work features idols, music, and dream-chasing. The anime's song-and-dance scenes are gorgeous, and the girls' efforts and bonds are moving—one of the works in the idol anime genre.

title: 枕男子
content: "Makura no Danshi" is a short anime telling the time spent with various handsome men before sleep. The work features female-oriented, healing, and fantasy elements; each episode revolves around one handsome man, and the anime creates an ambiguous pre-sleep atmosphere with exquisite art—a short work suitable for female viewers to relax.

title: 偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩 第二季
content: "The IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls" Season 2 continues the first season, as the Cinderella Girls keep growing on the idol path. This season revolves around the idols' activities and new challenges, with each character's story line deepening; the work features ensemble portrayal, music, and dream-chasing. The song-and-dance scenes are gorgeous, and the girls' growth and bonds are moving—an excellent idol anime.

title: Fate/kaleid liner 魔法少女☆伊莉雅 2wei Herz!
content: "Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya 2wei Herz!" is a Fate series spin-off anime, continuing Illya and Miyu's battles as magical girls. This season adds more characters and battles, with Illya's daily life and crises as a magical girl intertwining; the work features magical girl transformation, the Fate worldview, and daily comedy. The anime has both fan-service and passion—a uniquely styled work in the Fate series.

title: 魔鬼恋人 第二季
content: "Diabolik Lovers" Season 2 continues the first season, as girl Yui Komori's entanglement with the vampire brothers goes on. Yui's fate in the blood-sucking games deepens; the work features dark vampire settings, gorgeous characters, and ambiguous interactions. The anime has a strong Gothic atmosphere, and the forbidden relationships between Yui and the brothers are full of tension—an otome-oriented vampire work.

title: 见习神明 秘密的心灵 第一部
content: "Kamisama Minarai: Himitsu no Cocotama" is a short anime telling of apprentice god girls helping people's troubles. The girls resolve people's wishes as gods; the work features healing, daily life, and gods, with cute art and a warm atmosphere, conveying warmth in light stories—a healing work suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: 鲁邦三世
content: "Lupin the Third" is a classic phantom thief anime series, telling the adventures of Lupin the Third and his partners. Lupin steals treasures around the world, maneuvering against his rival Inspector Zenigata; the work features phantom thieves, adventure, and comedy. Lupin's wit and charm are captivating, and the anime's art and performances are full of period flavor—a classic in the history of Japanese animation.

title: 枪与假面舞会
content: This adapts the same-name light novel. In a world where masquerades flourish, boy Arata is drawn into battles using masks. The work features battle, mystery, and fantasy; Arata's growth and the truth of the masquerade unfold layer by layer, and the anime's battle scenes are gorgeous with novel settings—a fantasy battle work full of suspense.

title: 青年黑杰克
content: "Young Black Jack" adapts from Osamu Tezuka's masterpiece, telling the story of young Black Jack (Kuroo Hazama). The young Black Jack encounters various medical incidents in his medical student career, gradually forming his own medical philosophy; the work is themed on medicine, humanity, and darkness, with a heavy atmosphere and profound exploration. It is a modern interpretation of Tezuka's work, full of power and thought.

title: 影鳄
content: "Kagewani" is a short horror anime telling of the protagonist encountering Kagewani while investigating mysterious events. Kagewani is an unknown creature that devours humans; the work features horror, suspense, and episodic stories, with a cold art style and oppressive atmosphere, creating a strong sense of horror in limited length—a work that makes viewers think deeply.

title: 骇客娃娃
content: "Hacka Doll" is a short anime telling of three AI Hacka Dolls helping humans in daily life. The girl Hacka Dolls solve human problems in various ways; the work features sci-fi, comedy, and daily life, with cute art and brisk pacing, showing fun AI interactions in light episodic stories—a stress-relieving short anime.

title: 黑白小姐 第三季
content: "Miss Monochrome" Season 3 continues the series, as virtual idol Miss Monochrome keeps chasing her idol dream. Monochrome's daily life is still full of absurdity and laughs; the work features exaggerated performances and rapid-fire gags, and the anime is short with blazing pace, with endless funny stories in Monochrome's dream-chasing—a stress-relieving comedy short.

title: 重装武器
content: "Heavy Object" adapts the same-name light novel. On battlefields dominated by the OBJECT weapons, two boys challenge the gigantic OBJECTs as ordinary soldiers. The work features mech battles, war, and passion; the boys resist overwhelming force with wisdom and courage, and the battle scenes are gorgeous with the characters' growth and bonds running throughout—a powerful mech work.

title: 野良神 ARAGOTO
content: "Noragami Aragoto" is the second season of Noragami; Yato and Hiyori's story continues. This season revolves around Ebisu, Yomi, and Yato's past, with deeper battles and emotions; the work is known for modern mythology, passionate battle, and warm daily life. Yato gains new bonds in his search for self-worth, and the fight scenes are full of tension—a highly acclaimed fantasy work.

title: K 诸王归来
content: "K: Return of Kings" is a K series anime telling the battles between Kings with powers and their clans. This season revolves around the conflicts of Silver King Isana Yashiro and many Kings; the work features gorgeous character designs, superpower battles, and ensemble. The anime's color scheme and performances are visually impactful, and the Kings' fates and clan members' bonds run throughout—a uniquely styled work.

title: 苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS 第2部分
content: "Fafner EXODUS" Part 2 is a sequel to Fafner; the boys and girls pilot Fafner to continue fighting the Festum. This season's war is more brutal, and the second-generation pilots' sacrifices and growth are moving; the work is known for tragic war and profound exploration of life and death, with refined mech battle scenes and a heavy yet touching atmosphere—a classic of hardcore sci-fi anime.

title: 金田一少年事件簿R 2期
content: "Kindaichi Case Files R" Season 2 continues the series, as Hajime Kindaichi keeps solving difficult cases. This season's cases retain the charm of orthodox mystery, with ingenious puzzles of locked rooms and alibis; the work features mystery, suspense, and tense plot. Kindaichi's reasoning unravels thread by thread, and the surprising truths are impressive—a representative of Japanese mystery anime.

title: 传颂之物 虚伪的假面
content: "Utawarerumono: The False Faces" adapts the same-name game. Boy Haku, who lost his memory, is helped by the mysterious girl Kuon and joins the political struggles of the great nation Yamato. The work features fantasy, politics, and ensemble; Haku's growth and decisions in troubled times are full of tension, and the anime has a vast worldview and many characters, with the plot unfolding between adventure and scheming—a sequel in the Utawarerumono series.

title: Peeping Life TV シーズン1 ??
content: "Peeping Life TV" Season 1 is a short anime presenting various comedic scenes of daily life with a unique art style. The work features daily observation, deadpan humor, and parody, exaggerating ordinary life details; the anime has a distinctive art style and brisk pacing, delivering dense jokes in short length—a distinctly styled comedy short.

title: 家有穆珂
content: "Muco" adapts the same-name manga, telling the warm daily life of the golden retriever Muco and her glass craftsman master Komatsu. Muco observes the world from a dog's perspective, and her interactions with her master are healing; the work features pets, daily life, and warmth, with cute art and a warm atmosphere. Muco's cuteness and her master's gentleness bring knowing smiles—a healing pet daily work.

title: 学战都市 六芒星
content: "The Asterisk War" is the first season of the series, telling Ayato Amagiri's battles at Seidoukan Academy. Ayato joins the fighting to find out the truth about his sister's disappearance, competing in school duels against capable opponents; the work features school battles, passion, and fantasy. Ayato's growth and bonds with partners run throughout, and the battle scenes are gorgeous—a standard light-novel school battle anime.

title: 落第骑士英雄谭
content: "Chivalry of a Failed Knight" adapts the same-name light novel. At a magic knight academy, the failed knight Ikki Kurogane meets the strongest girl Stella Vermillion, and the two fight side by side. The work features school battles, passion, and romance; Ikki challenges strong enemies with swordsmanship and wisdom, and the battle scenes are gorgeous with sugary interactions between Ikki and Stella—a work combining passion and romance.

title: 终物语
content: "Owarimonogatari" is a Monogatari series anime telling of Koyomi Araragi's last spring of high school. This season revolves around the entanglements between Araragi, Suruga Kanbaru, and Oshino Ougi, with the series' mysteries gradually revealed; the work is known for its unique dialogue style, extreme visual expression, and contemplative narration. Araragi's choices in oddity incidents are profound—an important chapter of the Monogatari series.

title: KOWABON
content: "KOWABON" is a short horror anime depicting modern urban horror stories with 3DCG. The work features horror, suspense, and urban legends, with a unique art style and eerie atmosphere, creating a strong sense of horror in limited length; various spine-chilling stories send chills down viewers' spines—a must-see for horror anime fans.

title: 进击！巨人中学校
content: "Attack on Titan: Junior High" is a spin-off comedy anime of Attack on Titan, placing the original characters into a middle school daily life. Eren, Mikasa, and others carry out comedic daily life at school; the work features parody, snark, and daily life, completely comedifying the serious Attack on Titan setting. The anime is short with dense jokes—a light work Attack on Titan fans shouldn't miss.

title: 排球少年 第二季
content: "Haikyu!!" Season 2 continues the first season, as Karasuno High's volleyball team keeps fighting. Hinata and Kageyama grow through training camps and matches; this season's opponents are stronger, and the work is known for realistic volleyball portrayal, passionate matches, and team growth. The whole Karasuno team's efforts and bonds make viewers' blood boil—a classic sports anime.

title: 机动战士高达 铁血的奥尔芬斯
content: "Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans" is a Gundam series anime telling the battles of boys from Mars. Mikazuki and the Tekkadan group take up mechs to resist oppression on Mars; the work features mech battles, passion, and ensemble. The Tekkadan boys struggle to survive in a cruel world, and the battle scenes are brutal with the characters' sacrifices and convictions moving—a uniquely styled work in the Gundam series.

title: 温泉幼精箱根酱
content: "Onsen Yousei Hakone-chan" is a short anime telling the daily life of the hot spring fairy Hakone-chan and boy Touya. Hakone-chan comes to the human world and meets Touya; the work features healing, hot springs, and daily life, with cute art and a light atmosphere, unfolding warm interactions against a hot spring backdrop—a healing short anime suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: 雨色可可 欢迎来到Rainy color！
content: "Rainy Cocoa: Welcome to Rainy Color!" is a Rainy Cocoa series work telling the daily life of the cafe Rainy Color. This season continues the cafe's warm stories, with the staff and customers' interactions full of healing; the work features healing, daily life, and coffee, with fresh art and a tranquil atmosphere—a healing work suitable for relaxed viewing.

title: 小森同学拒绝不了！
content: "Komori-san wa Kotowarenai!" adapts the same-name manga. Komori-san cannot refuse others' requests, constantly getting drawn into various incidents in daily life. The work features comedy, daily life, and snark; Komori's troubles and her interactions with those around her are full of gags, and the anime is short with brisk pacing, showing Komori's cuteness in light daily life—a stress-relieving short anime.

title: 彗星路西法
content: "Comet Lucifer" is an original anime telling of boy Sougo meeting a mysterious girl in a mining town. Sougo and the girl Lucy learn the world's secrets through adventure; the work is themed on fantasy, adventure, and growth, with beautiful visuals and a warm atmosphere. The bond between Sougo and Lucy runs throughout—an adventure work full of healing.

title: Concrete Revolutio 超人幻想
content: "Concrete Revolutio: Choujin Gensou" is the first season of the series, telling of the Superhuman Bureau handling various superhuman matters in a world where superhumans coexist with humans. Protagonist Jirou Hitoyoshi's choices between justice and order run throughout; the work is known for its complex narrative structure and sharp social criticism, exploring heavy themes of heroes, humanity, and the times—a uniquely styled fantasy ensemble drama.

title: 一拳超人
content: "One-Punch Man" adapts the same-name manga. Hero Saitama, possessing absolute power, is bored with fighting due to his overwhelming strength; the work is themed on passionate battle, comedy, and heroes. The satisfaction of Saitama one-punching enemies and the ensemble portrayal of various heroes complement each other, and the battle scenes are gorgeous and stunning—one of the most influential passionate works in recent years.

title: 女高中生给你做饭了！
content: This is a short anime telling of high school girls making dishes. The work features food, daily life, and healing; the girls' process of making various dishes is fun, and the anime combines tempting food with the girls' interactions, with cute art and a light atmosphere—a short work with both food and moe.

title: 网球并不可笑嘛 6期
content: "Teekyuu" Season 6 continues the series, as the tennis club girls' nonsensical daily life goes on. The work features rapid-fire gags, exaggerated performances, and wild-brain segments, turning tennis into various hilarious scenes; each episode is extremely short yet packed with jokes—a light short anime that makes viewers laugh out loud, perfect for stress relief in spare time.

title: 阿松
content: "Mr. Osomatsu" adapts Osamu Akatsuka's classic manga, telling the daily life of the six Matsuno twins. The six look the same but have different personalities, causing various jokes in their slacker life; the work features parody, snark, and social satire, with bold daring performances, hinting at satire of reality beneath the nonsensical daily life—a phenomenal comedy anime.

title: 摇曳百合 3☆High!
content: "YuruYuri San☆Hai!" is a YuruYuri series anime telling the daily life of the Amusement Club girls at Nanamori Middle School. Akari and her friends spend happy times in the club room; the work features yuri, daily life, and comedy, with the girls' interactions full of charm and gags. The anime has cute art and a light atmosphere—a classic yuri daily anime.

title: 高校星歌剧
content: "High School Star Musical" is a music anime telling the growth of students in the music department of the star academy. To reach their dream stage, the boys train and chase dreams at the academy; the work features music, youth, and ensemble, with distinct characters and infectious song-and-dance scenes. The anime has a warm and inspirational atmosphere—a music work full of positive energy.

title: 新我们这一家
content: "Shin Atashin'chi" is a sequel to the Atashin'chi series, telling the hilarious daily life of the Hanawa family. Mii-chan's ordinary family life with her husband and children is full of gags; the work features family comedy, daily life, and snark, vividly portraying the trivia of family life with a warm atmosphere—a comedy work full of life flavor.

title: 绯弹的亚里亚AA
content: "Aria the Scarlet Ammo AA" is a spin-off of Aria the Scarlet Ammo, telling the battles of the girls at the armed detective high school.
